blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.
blocks.zh: 视觉语言模型(VLMs)融合视觉和文字信息,但其输出并不揭示内部概念表现. 全球工作空间理论(GWT)建议,信息从平行的大脑流程中选择,集成在一个共享的工作空间中,并提供给专门的流程. 我们引入了多式联运概念镜头(MC-Lens),这是一种多式雅各布镜头,用于研究VLM概念处理中的这些功能. 它的视觉编码器和语言解码器透镜将中间态映射到一个由解码器输出词汇定义的共享语义空间,以比较跨模式的概念无障碍性. MC-Lens支持内部概念干预,以审查访问概念在下游计算中的作用. (i) 无障碍和有选择的准入。 多式联运概念信息可在中间国家读取,并根据任务需要有选择地提供。 我们把“读出载体”从一个名称符号扩展到一个符号集,以便更好地捕捉和表达概念信息,并支持反事实实验。 (二) 下游计算的概念。 反事实实验显示,获得的概念信息参与下游的计算和推理. (三)发展跨模式对接和选择性准入. 我们开发了两个J空间度量衡,跟踪跨模式概念对齐的发展比在受控VLM训练中隐藏的状态余弦更清晰. 实验还显示,可靠的选择性访问比概念的可访问性发展得晚. (四) 各种模式的共享职能。 在整个VLM家庭和规模中,我们发现,尽管内部组织存在差异,但概念无障碍性、依赖查询的选择性和跨任务干预效应方面有着共同的模式。 这些结论为研究多式联运人工系统中的GWT以及它如何指导改进跨模式协调提供了一个实验基础。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Vision-language models (VLMs) can effectively integrate visual and textual information to perform a range of multimodal tasks ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Li et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2023 ; Bai et al., 2025 ) .
For example, we can ask a VLM to identify an object in an image or describe its colour, and these questions require the model to extract different information from the same image and integrate it with the textual query.
However, although current VLMs can readily answer these questions, their outputs do not reveal their internal concept representations.
A VLM can also answer a visual question incorrectly even when the visual information needed to answer it remains readable from its intermediate states ( Fu et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
视觉语言模型(VLMs)可以有效整合视觉和文字信息,以完成一系列的多式联运任务(Alayrac等人,2022年;Li等人,2023年;Liu等人,2023年;Bai等人,2025年).
例如,我们可以要求一个VLM在图像中识别一个对象或描述其颜色,这些问题要求模型从同一个图像中提取不同的信息,并将其与文字查询整合.
然而,虽然目前的自愿活动清单可以很容易地回答这些问题,但其产出并未揭示其内部概念表述。
VLM也可以错误地回答一个视觉问题,即使回答它所需的视觉信息仍然可以从它的中间状态读取(Fu等人,2025年).

blocks.en:
Existing interpretability methods aim to identify information in internal states and examine its role in producing model outputs ( Alain and Bengio, 2016 ; Neo et al., 2025 ; Kaduri et al., 2025 ) . Gurnee et al. (2026) proposed the Jacobian Lens (J-Lens), a Jacobian-based method that provides vocabulary-based readouts of intermediate language-model states.
Specifically, it maps the model’s intermediate hidden states into the space of final-layer decoder states via averaged Jacobian matrices, and provides concept directions for counterfactual intervention experiments.
Using J-Lens, Gurnee et al. (2026) identify functional and structural properties associated with a global workspace in large language models (LLMs).
blocks.zh:
现有的可解释性方法旨在查明国内各州的信息,并审查其在生产模型产出方面的作用(Alain and Bengio, 2016年;Neo等人, 2025年;Kaduri等人, 2025年)。 Gurnee等人(2026年)提出雅各布伦斯(J-Lens),一种基于雅各布伦斯的方法,提供基于词汇的中间语言模型状态读取.
具体来说,它通过平均Jacobian矩阵将模型的中间隐藏状态映射到最终层解码器状态的空间,并为反事实干预实验提供概念方向.
使用J-Lens,Gurnee等人(2026年)识别与大语言模型(LLMs)中的全球工作空间相关的功能和结构属性.

blocks.en:
In brain science, global workspace theory (GWT) ( Baars, 2005 ; Baars and Franklin, 2007 ; Dehaene et al., 1998 ) is an influential theory of consciousness that explains how information from different sources is integrated to support flexible cognition.
The core hypothesis of this theory is that information is selected from the multiple parallel processes in the brain, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to different specialised processes.
Building on the J-Lens study, we extend this analysis to concept information expressed through different modalities, and processed across the visual and language components of VLMs.
blocks.zh:
在脑科学中,全球工作空间理论(GWT)(Baars,2005年;Baars and Franklin,2007年;Dehaene等人,1998年)是一个有影响力的意识理论,它解释了来自不同来源的信息如何被集成以支持灵活的认知.
这一理论的核心假设是,信息是从大脑的多个平行过程中选择的,集成在一个共享的工作空间中,并提供给不同的专业过程.
在J-Lens研究的基础上,我们把这一分析扩大到通过不同方式表达的概念信息,并在整个VLM的视觉和语言组件中得到处理.

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens that combines a vision encoder lens (V-Lens) and a language decoder lens (L-Lens).
V-Lens can access concept information from intermediate vision encoder states before visual information is combined with the text input in the decoder.
L-Lens can access concept information from decoder states during the integration of visual and textual inputs, allowing us to examine selective access under different text queries and during autoregressive generation.
Both V-Lens and L-Lens map intermediate states into a shared semantic space defined by the decoder’s output vocabulary, so we can compare concept accessibility during multimodal information integration and processing.
Figure 1 illustrates these readouts in a visual question answering (VQA) example.
We conduct counterfactual experiments using MC-Lens, where we intervene on intermediate state components associated with the accessed concepts and observe the resulting model outputs, to infer the role of these concepts in downstream computation.
In addition, we also investigate the functional properties and internal organisation of multimodal concept processing in VLMs in relation to GWT.
Specifically, our experiments address four related aspects.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍了"多式联运概念镜头"(MC-Lens),即结合视觉编码器镜头(V-Lens)和语言解码器镜头(L-Lens)的多模式雅各镜头.
V-Lens可以在视觉信息与解码器中的文本输入结合之前,从中间视觉编码器状态获取概念信息.
L-Lens可以在将视觉输入和文本输入整合的过程中从解码状态获取概念信息,使我们能够在不同的文本查询中以及在自递生成过程中检查选择性访问.
V-Lens和L-Lens都将中间状态映射成一个由解码器输出词汇定义的共享语义空间,这样我们就可以比较在多式联运信息集成和处理过程中的概念无障碍性.
图1以视觉问答(VQA)为例说明了这些读取。
我们利用MC-Lens进行反事实实验,在这种实验中,我们干预与访问概念有关的中间状态组件,并观察由此产生的模型输出,推断这些概念在下游计算中的作用。
此外,我们还调查了与GWT有关的VLMs中多式联运概念处理的功能属性和内部组织。
具体而言,我们的实验涉及四个相关方面。

blocks.en:
(i) Accessibility and selective access. Our experiments show that multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and can be selectively accessed according to task demands.
Spatial readouts further reveal object identity and attributes such as colour and material at a fine spatial scale.
In addition, we extend the “readout carriers” used to express a concept, from a single name token to a set of tokens.
This extension helps us better capture and express concept information in intermediate states, and supports subsequent counterfactual experiments on its role in downstream computation.
blocks.zh:
(i) 无障碍和有选择的准入。 我们的实验表明,多式联运概念信息可以在中间状态中读取,可以根据任务需求有选择地获取。
空间读取以细微的空间尺度进一步揭示物体身份和属性,如颜色和材料.
此外,我们将用来表达一个概念的“读取载体”从一个单一的名称符号扩大到一组符号。
这个扩展帮助我们在中间状态中更好地捕捉和表达概念信息,并支持随后关于其在下游计算中的作用的反事实实验.

blocks.en:
(ii) Concepts in downstream computation. The counterfactual experiments indicate that the concept information we access is not merely shown on a “display board”, but also participates in downstream computation and reasoning.
In causal reasoning VQA tasks, we perform counterfactual interventions on intermediate concept representations, and find that these interventions can redirect answers to questions requiring multiple steps of reasoning, or influence multiple aspects of downstream reasoning.
And we find that these effects generally become stronger as we expand the “readout carriers” using larger concept direction sets.
blocks.zh:
(二) 下游计算的概念。 反事实实验表明,我们获取的概念信息不仅显示在“显示板上”,而且还参与下游的计算和推理。
在因果推理VQA任务中,我们对中间概念表述进行反事实干预,发现这些干预可以将答案重定向到需要多个推理步骤的问题,或者影响下游推理的多个方面.
我们发现,随着我们利用更大的概念组合来扩展“读取载体”,这些效应一般会变得更强。

blocks.en:
(iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space based metrics to track correspondence between visual states and language-defined concepts.
We also construct a controlled VLM training setting for vision-language alignment, and evaluate these metrics across checkpoints at different stages of training.
Our experiments show that our proposed metrics reflect the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than the hidden state cosine baseline.
Concept readouts from the same checkpoints further show that concept accessibility improves early in alignment training, whereas reliable selective access develops later.
blocks.zh:
(三)发展跨模式对接和选择性准入. 我们开发了两个基于J空间的度量衡来跟踪视觉状态和语言定义的概念之间的对应.
我们还为视线语言统一设计了一个受控的甚高频培训环境,并在培训的不同阶段对各检查站的这些指标进行评价。
我们的实验表明,我们提议的衡量标准比隐蔽的宇宙基线更清楚地反映了跨模式概念协调的发展。
从同一检查站读取的概念进一步表明,概念的无障碍性在调整培训的早期就有所改善,而可靠的选择性接入则在后来发展。

blocks.en:
(iv) Shared functions across models. We extend our experiments to VLMs of different sizes from multiple model families ( Bai et al., 2025 ; Wu et al., 2024 ; Gemma Team, 2025 ) .
Across these models, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects, despite differences in their internal workspace organisation.
blocks.zh:
(四) 各种模式的共享职能。 我们的实验扩大到来自多个模范家庭的大小不同的VLM(Bai等人,2025年;Wu等人,2024年;Gemma Team,2025年)。
在这些模式中,我们发现,尽管内部工作空间组织存在差异,但概念无障碍性、依赖查询的选择性和跨任务干预效应是共同的模式。

blocks.en: Together, these findings provide an experimental basis for studying GWT in multimodal artificial systems, and open a way to investigate how GWT can guide improvements in cross-modal alignment.
blocks.zh: 这些结论共同为在多式联运人工系统中研究GWT提供了一个实验基础,并为研究GWT如何指导改进跨模式对齐提供了一个途径。

blocks.en: 2 MC-Lens: A Jacobian Lens for Multimodal Concepts
blocks.zh: 2 MC-Lens:促进多式联运概念的Jacobian Lens

blocks.en:
In general, a VLM’s output provides only a limited view of its internal processing.
For example, a VLM may correctly identify a bicycle in a photograph, but the answer itself does not tell us where the concept of bicycle appears inside the model.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,VLM的输出只能对其内部处理提供有限的视角.
例如,VLM可能在照片中正确识别自行车,但答案本身并没有告诉我们自行车的概念在模型内出现在哪里.

blocks.en:
Therefore, we develop MC-Lens, a Jacobian-based method inspired by J-Lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) , to access concept information from intermediate states in the VLM and to investigate the role of the accessed concepts in downstream computation and reasoning.
In this section, we focus on the mathematical formulation of MC-Lens.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们开发了基于J-Lens(Gurnee等人,2026年)的基于Jacobian的方法MC-Lens,以获取来自VLM中中间状态的概念信息,并调查所访问的概念在下游计算和推理中的作用.
在本节中,我们侧重于MC-Lens的数学配体.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multimodal Jacobian Lenses
blocks.zh: 2.1 雅各布伦斯多式联运

blocks.en:
In this part, we introduce MC-Lens, a multimodal Jacobian lens that combines V-Lens and L-Lens.
V-Lens and L-Lens both apply an averaged Jacobian matrix to measure the effects of intermediate hidden states on the final-layer decoder hidden states in the VLM.
V-Lens measures the effect of an intermediate vision encoder state on the final-layer decoder hidden state, while L-Lens measures the corresponding effect of an intermediate language decoder state.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们引入了MC-Lens,一种结合V-Lens和L-Lens的多式雅各镜头.
V-Lens和L-Lens都应用一个平均的雅各布矩阵来测量中间隐藏状态对VLM中最终层解码器隐藏状态的影响.
V-Lens测量中间视觉编码器状态对最终层解码器隐藏状态的影响,而L-Lens测量中间语言解码器状态的相应效果.

blocks.en:
However, such a Jacobian matrix mixes two things: the particular use of the intermediate state in the current context, and the general effect it has on later outputs across contexts.
J-Lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) isolates the general effect by averaging the Jacobian matrices within and across inputs.
Specifically, within each input, it sums the Jacobian matrices over the final-layer positions q q and averages over the intermediate positions p p , and it then averages across a corpus of text prompts.
In this way, for a given model, we obtain one averaged Jacobian matrix per layer, which serves as the lens for that layer.
blocks.zh:
然而,这样的雅各布矩阵混合了两件事:在当前背景下对中间状态的特殊使用,以及它对后期各背景产出的一般影响.
J-Lens(Gurnee等人,2026年)通过在输入物内和输入物之间平均的雅各布亚矩阵来隔离一般效应.
具体地说,在每个输入中,它将雅各布日矩阵在最后的 q q 位置和中间的 p 位置的平均值相加,然后在一系列文字提示中平均相加。
这样,对于一个特定的模型, 我们得到一个平均的雅各布矩阵 每层, 它作为该层的透镜。

blocks.en:
This uniform averaging strategy in J-Lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) suits a language model, since all input positions belong to the same category of text tokens.
However, in VLMs, image tokens often greatly outnumber text tokens ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , while text tokens carry the question and other task information and can disproportionately influence the final output ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Deng et al., 2025 ) .
The uniform averaging strategy over the whole sequence would therefore give image positions a larger total weight than text positions in the lens estimate.
In addition, in a VLM, the vision encoder processes a sequence of image patches, and the language decoder processes a mixed sequence of image, text and template tokens, so the two lenses need different position sets.
We therefore present a unified formulation for V-Lens and L-Lens, and then specify the settings for each lens.
blocks.zh:
J-Lens(Gurnee et al., 2026)中的这种统一平均策略适合一种语言模式,因为所有输入位置都属于同一类文本符号.
然而,在VLMs中,图像符号往往大大超过文本符号(Yang等人,2025年),而文本符号则携带问题和其他任务信息,并可能不成比例地影响最终产出(Chen等人,2024年;Deng等人,2025年).
因此,对整个序列的统一平均战略将使图像位置的总重量大于镜头估计中的文本位置。
此外,在VLM中,视觉编码器处理一个图像补丁的序列,语言解码器处理一个图像,文本和模板符号的混合序列,因此两个镜头需要不同的位置集.
因此,我们提出了V-Lens和L-Lens的统一配方,然后指定每个镜头的设置.

blocks.en:
We estimate V-Lens and L-Lens from N N VQA examples x i x_{i} , each consisting of an image, a question and the corresponding answer.

blocks.en:
The intermediate position set 𝒫 i \mathcal{P}_{i} depends on the lens: for V-Lens it contains the encoder patch positions, and for L-Lens the decoder token positions.
We further group 𝒫 i \mathcal{P}_{i} into categories 𝒞 i , c \mathcal{C}_{i,c} , indexed by a category set 𝒦 \mathcal{K} .
For V-Lens, 𝒦 \mathcal{K} has a single category containing all patches, and for L-Lens it has three categories: image, text and template tokens.
We average within each category and then across categories.
This gives each category equal total weight, regardless of how many tokens it contains.

Appendix A.1 lists further excluded positions.

blocks.en: 2.2 Vocabulary-Based Concept Readout
blocks.zh: 2.2 基于词汇的概念读取

blocks.en:
Suppose a VQA task asks the model to identify the object in an input image of a bicycle.
The model can easily answer “bicycle”.
However, this answer alone does not tell us where the concept of bicycle appears inside the model.
Here, we want to figure out at which layer this concept already appears in the model’s internal states before the answer is produced.
blocks.zh:
如果一个 VQA 任务要求模型在自行车的输入图像中识别对象.
该模型很容易回答“自行车”。
然而,单靠这个答案并不能告诉我们自行车的概念在模型中出现在哪里.
在此,我们想找出这个概念在模型的内部状态中已经出现在哪个层次,然后才给出答案。

(A) V-Lens and L-Lens map intermediate states into the decoder’s final-layer state space, then use its output head to rank vocabulary tokens. (B) The readout state is taken from one position or averaged over a position set 𝒮 \mathcal{S} . (C) Reference centring subtracts μ ℓ \mu_{\ell} , the mean state over reference inputs.

blocks.en:
In this part, we use MC-Lens to read an intermediate state by projecting the state onto the decoder’s output vocabulary (Figure 3 (A)).
The readout gives a logit for every word in the vocabulary.
We then rank all words by these logits, and the ranks tell us which words the state is close to.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们通过将状态投影到解码器输出词汇(图3(A))来读取中间状态.
读出时给出了词汇中每个单词的登录.
然后我们按这些日志排列所有字, 分级告诉我们哪个字是国家接近的。

blocks.en:
In this VQA example of identifying a bicycle, if an intermediate state ranks the word ‘‘bicycle’’ near the top, we regard the concept as readable in that state, and we use the rank of the concept name to measure how accessible the concept is.
The concept readout here corresponds to one token in the vocabulary, so we call such a concept a single-token concept. 1 1 1 A word can be tokenised in different ways. In the Qwen3-VL tokeniser, for example, bicycle without a leading space is split into the sub-word tokens b and icycle , while ␣bicycle with its leading space is one token. Here we first discuss the latter case, where one token represents a concept.
blocks.zh:
在这个识别自行车的VQA例子中,如果一个中间状态将“自行车”一词排在顶端,我们认为这个概念在该状态中是可读的,我们用概念名称的排名来衡量这个概念是如何无障碍的。
这里的概念读出与词汇中的一个符号相对应,所以我们称这样的概念为单键概念. 111 一个词可以用不同的方式表示. 例如,在Quen3-VL 令牌器中,没有领头空间的自行车被拆分为子词令牌b和icycle,而拥有领头空间的QQ自行车则是一个令牌. 在这里,我们首先讨论后一种情况,一种象征代表一种概念。

blocks.en:
We use different position sets for V-Lens in the vision encoder and L-Lens in the language decoder to select the intermediate state h h .
In the vision encoder, V-Lens reads either the state of a single patch or the mean state of all image patches.
A single patch state tells us which concepts are readable at the corresponding spatial location, and the mean state over patches provides a readout for the whole image.
blocks.zh:
我们在视觉编码器中使用不同的V-Lens位置集,在语言解码器中使用L-Lens来选择中间状态 h .
在视觉编码器中,V-Lens要么读取单个补丁的状态,要么读取所有图像补丁的平均值.
一个单一的补丁状态告诉我们哪些概念在相应的空间位置是可读的,平均状态超过补丁为整个图像提供了读取.

blocks.en:
In the language decoder, L-Lens likewise reads either the state of a single token or the mean state over a set of tokens.
For a single state, we typically read the pre-answer state, the decoder state at the last token position before the answer.
This state tells us which concepts are readable after the model has combined the image with the question and right before it answers.
For a mean state, we average the decoder image-token states.
These tokens originate from the encoder patches through the connector, so their mean is the decoder counterpart of the mean patch state.
blocks.zh:

对于单个状态,我们一般读作预答状态,解码状态在回答之前的最后一个符号位置.
这个状态告诉我们,在模型将图像与问题结合后,哪些概念是可以读取的,在答案之前。

In the bicycle VQA example, reading a patch in the bicycle region via V-Lens tells us whether the concept bicycle is readable at that spatial location, and reading the mean patch state via V-Lens tells us whether it is readable from the photograph as a whole.
Reading the pre-answer state via L-Lens tells us whether bicycle is readable in the internal state after the model has collected the information from the image and the question, right before it answers.
blocks.zh:
在自行车VQA的例子中,通过V-Lens读取自行车区域的一个补丁告诉我们概念自行车在该空间位置是否可以读取,通过V-Lens读取的平均值补丁状态告诉我们从整体照片看是否可以读取.
通过L-Lens读取预答状态告诉我们,在模型从图像和问题中收集到信息之后,自行车在内部状态下是否可以读取,就在它回答之前.

blocks.en:
The readout method described so far works well for the pre-answer state, but has a limitation for visual states (encoder patch states and decoder image-token states).
The same tokens tend to appear near the top for different images, and the name of the object in the image is buried below tokens that are uninformative about the object.
blocks.zh:
迄今描述的读出方法对于预答状态效果良好,但对视觉状态(编码器补丁状态和解码器映像托肯状态)有限制.
同样的同物往往出现在不同的图像的顶部附近,图像中对象的名字被埋藏在对对象没有印象的符号下面.

blocks.en:
We assume that intermediate states contain a large component common to different images, and this component enters the scores in Equation 8 together with the image-specific part.
This assumption is also consistent with the findings of Shukor and Cord (2024) , who observed that mean visual-token states from different images point in similar directions in the language decoder.
We therefore introduce reference centring (Figure 3 (C)), which subtracts a reference state from h h before the readout.
For the reference state, we compute the readout state in the same way as in Equation 10 , at the same layer, for each of N ref N_{\mathrm{ref}} natural reference images x r ref x_{r}^{\mathrm{ref}} (ordinary photographs).

blocks.en: 2.3 Constructing Concept Direction Sets
blocks.zh: 2.3 构建概念方向集

blocks.en:
So far, we have used MC-Lens to access concept information from intermediate hidden states in a verbalised form.
However, we found that the hidden state usually carries more information about a concept than its name token expresses.
For example, in the bicycle VQA task, ␣bicycle is not the only token that expresses the concept, for two reasons.
(1) Different word forms may express the same concept, such as ␣Bicycle , ␣bike and ␣bicycles .
(2) Surrounding concepts can also express part of the meaning of this concept.
Some are concepts that are closely linked to a bicycle, such as ␣riders and ␣road , and some are parts of a bicycle or the category it belongs to, such as ␣handle and ␣transport . 3 3 3 Here we mean concepts associated with a single object, rather than other objects present in the image. Even when the image shows a bicycle against a blank background, the hidden state may still carry information associated with ␣riders , ␣road and ␣handle .

迄今为止,我们利用MC-Lens以口头形式获取中间隐藏状态的概念信息。
然而,我们发现,隐藏状态通常携带更多有关一个概念的信息,而不是其名称符号表达的信息.
例如,在自行车VQA任务中,QQ自行车并不是表达这个概念的唯一标志,原因有二.
(1) 不同的单词形式可以表达相同的概念,如‘bicle',‘bicle'和‘bicle'.
(2) 环绕的概念也可以表达这一概念的部分含义.
有些是和自行车紧密相连的概念,如 骑手和␣路,有些是自行车的一部分或其所属的类别,如 手和␣交通. 3 3 3 这里我们指与单个对象有关的概念,而不是图像中的其他对象. 即使画面显示一辆自行车,

blocks.en:
This phenomenon is especially pronounced in VLMs.
In an LLM, the word “bicycle” enters the hidden state as the token ␣bicycle itself.
However, in a VLM, the concept enters from the image, which has no such token to anchor it, so we expect the concept to be spread over more vocabulary tokens in the hidden state.
The readout and counterfactual experiments in Sections 3.2 and 5.1 support this view.

这种现象在VLMs中尤为突出.
在LLM中,“自行车”一词作为符号QQ自行车本身进入隐藏状态。
然而,在VLM中,这个概念从图像中进入,它没有这样的符号来锚定它,所以我们期望这个概念被分散到隐藏状态中更多的词汇符号上.
第3.2和5.1节中的读出和反事实实验支持这一观点。

In this part, we therefore describe a concept with a set of tokens rather than one token.
J-Lens describes a single-token concept by the vocabulary direction of its token ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
Here, we select a set of tokens for each concept and use their vocabulary directions as its concept directions.
Together, these directions form the concept direction set.
We choose these vocabulary tokens in two ways: (1) word-form selection and (2) greedy selection via J-space reconstruction.
Below, we first review the definitions of vocabulary direction and J-space from J-Lens, and then describe the two selection methods.

The word-form selection we described above is based on pre-defined tokens, which does not guarantee that the hidden state actually uses these vocabulary directions for expressing the concept.
Here we introduce greedy selection to reconstruct the concept-specific part of the hidden state, using vocabulary directions chosen from the whole vocabulary.
J-Lens uses a related sparse decomposition to analyse which vocabulary directions are active in a state ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
We instead use the selected tokens as the direction set of a concept, for both readout and intervention.

Suppose that, in a VQA task, the input is an image of a Canadian flag and the question asks for the capital of the flag’s country.
The model answers “Ottawa”.
Section 2.2 tells us whether the concept Canada is readable in an intermediate hidden state, and Section 2.3 gives the concept directions for Canada .
Here we want to find out whether the concept of Canada we access in the intermediate state is used to “compute” the answer about its capital, or is merely shown on a “display board”.

blocks.en: 3 Multimodal Concept Accessibility
blocks.zh: 3 多式联运概念无障碍

blocks.en: In brain science, GWT proposes that conscious access involves making information available to multiple specialised processes through a shared workspace ( Baars, 2005 ) .
blocks.zh: 在脑科学方面,GWT建议,有意识的获取涉及通过共享工作空间向多个专门进程提供信息(Baars,2005年)。

blocks.en:
To investigate the potential relationship between GWT and multimodal information integration and processing in VLMs, we use our proposed MC-Lens to examine concept accessibility in intermediate states.
We first examine concept readability in intermediate states under different combinations of multimodal inputs.
We then extend the analysis to different “readout carriers”, from a single name token to sets of tokens, comparing their ability to express the target concept and reconstruct the intermediate state.
We finally examine spatial-level concept accessibility in visual states across network layers and image locations.
Together, these experiments provide a preliminary evaluation of MC-Lens and these “readout carriers” for studying multimodal information in intermediate states.
blocks.zh:
为了调查GWT与VLMs的多式联运信息整合和处理之间的潜在关系,我们利用我们提议的MC-Lens来审查中间状态的概念可获取性。
我们首先根据不同组合的多式联运投入审查中间国家的概念可读性。
然后,我们将分析扩大到不同的“读取载体”,从一个单一的名称符号到几套符号,比较它们表达目标概念和重建中间状态的能力。
我们最终审查了跨网络层和图像位置的视觉状态下的空间级概念无障碍性。
这些实验共同对MC-Lens和这些“读取载体”进行了初步评价,用于研究中间国家的多式联运信息。

blocks.en: 3.1 Concept Accessibility across Evidence Conditions
blocks.zh: 3.1 跨证据条件的无障碍概念

blocks.en:
In this part, we investigate concept accessibility in intermediate states with MC-Lens, under different conditions of model input.
Specifically, we use VQA as a task setting to compare concept accessibility when relevant task evidence is provided by an image or by text.
As illustrated in Example 3.1 , we construct four evidence conditions for each question: 1) an image containing evidence for the target concept, with no extra text evidence, 2) a sentence explicitly naming the target concept, with a blank image, 3) both, or 4) neither.
We collect 100 VQA cases from A-OKVQA ( Schwenk et al., 2022 ) , each with a single-word answer, such as the name of an object or a colour.
For each case, we use the ground-truth answer as the target concept for our experiment, and the target concept is fixed across the four evidence conditions.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们调查了在模型输入的不同条件下,在具有MC-Lens的中间状态中的概念无障碍性.
具体地说,当相关任务证据由图像或文本提供时,我们使用VQA作为任务设置来比较概念可获取性.
如例3.1所示,我们为每个问题构建四个证据条件: 1)包含目标概念证据的图像,没有额外的文本证据,2)明确命名目标概念的句子,空白图像,3)两者,或4)均无.
我们从A-OKVQA(Schwenk等人,2022年)收集100个VQA案例,每个案例都有一个单词的答案,如物体名称或颜色.
对于每一个案例,我们使用地面真实的答案作为我们实验的目标概念,目标概念固定在四个证据条件之间.

blocks.en:
We apply the proposed L-Lens to the pre-answer position in decoder layer D32 of Qwen3-VL-8B in this experiment, and then analyse the rank of the target concept token among all vocabulary tokens based on the readout scores.
We measure Pass ⁡ @ ​ K \operatorname{Pass}@K (where K K is a rank threshold), the fraction of cases where the target token appears in the top- K K ranking, and higher values indicate better concept accessibility.

blocks.en: 3.2 Extending Concept Readout Carriers
blocks.zh: 3.2 扩展概念读取载体

blocks.en:
In Section 3.1 , we used a single name token as the “readout carrier” for a concept, following J-Lens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
This token gives one way to name the concept (e.g., ␣bicycle → \rightarrow the concept of a bicycle ), but the same concept can be expressed through different tokens (e.g., the concept of a bicycle → \rightarrow ␣bicycle , ␣bike , ␣Bicycle , etc.).
blocks.zh:

这个符号给出了命名这个概念的一种方法(例如 QQ自行车 ~\ 右移自行车的概念 ),但同一概念可以通过不同的符号来表示(例如 自行车 ~\ 右移自行车 , QQ自行车 , QQ自行车 等).

blocks.en:
Here, we extend the analysis to sets of tokens as “readout carriers”.
Specifically, we compare two types of concept direction sets: the word-form sets F ≤ j F_{\leq j} and the greedy sets J ​ @ ​ k J@k , as illustrated in Figure 4 .
We want to examine the readability of these sets and their ability to reconstruct the state.

我们想审查这些设备的可读性以及它们重建国家的能力。

The actual number of flag images included in the quantitative analysis is 46, since four countries lack a complete single-token name for F 0 F_{0} . For each case, we use the ground-truth answer as the target concept and compare the sets on the same intermediate state.
We include the name-token set F 0 F_{0} , the cumulative word-form sets F ≤ 1 F_{\leq 1} , F ≤ 2 F_{\leq 2} and F ≤ 3 F_{\leq 3} , and the greedy sets J ​ @ ​ 15 J@15 , J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 and J ​ @ ​ 35 J@35 for comparison.
For readout, we apply L-Lens at decoder layer D32 of Qwen3-VL-8B to the pre-answer state.

blocks.en: 3.3 Concept Accessibility in Visual States
blocks.zh: 3.3 视觉国家的无障碍概念

blocks.en:
In Sections 3.1 and 3.2 , we examined concept accessibility in the pre-answer state in the language decoder using L-Lens, and here we extend our analysis to intermediate states at visual token positions.
We first examine concept accessibility across network sub-modules and depths, and then examine the correspondence between patch-level concept readouts and the locations of objects and attributes in the image.
blocks.zh:
在第3.1和3.2节中,我们用L-Lens语言解码器研究了预答状态中的概念可获取性,在这里,我们将分析扩展到视标位置的中间状态。
我们首先审查跨网络子模块和深度的概念可访问性,然后审查补丁级概念读取与图像中对象和属性的位置之间的对应性.

blocks.en: In this experiment, we examine visual concept accessibility across network sub-modules and depths.
blocks.zh: 在这个实验中,我们考察了跨网络子模块和深度的视觉概念无障碍性.

blocks.en:
We select 32 object concepts, with four images for each concept (128 images in total) from THINGS ( Hebart et al., 2019 ) .
For each image, we use the main object shown as the target concept.
Since we want to evaluate concept accessibility in visual states without the influence of a text question, we use only the image as the user input in this experiment.
This experiment is conducted on Qwen3-VL-8B, using both V-Lens and L-Lens.
For the visual encoder, we use V-Lens to read the mean encoder patch state, and for the language decoder, we use L-Lens to read the mean decoder image-token state.
For the connector, we read the mean visual state using the lenses fitted to its intermediate states (Appendix A.1 ).
As described in Section 2.2 , we apply the centring strategy here to make the concept more readable (Appendix B.2 ).
blocks.zh:
我们从MthingS(Hebart et al., 2019)中选择32个对象概念,每个概念有4个图像(共计128个图像).
对于每个图像,我们使用显示为目标概念的主体.
由于我们希望在没有文本问题的影响下评价可视状态下的概念可获取性,我们只使用图像作为这个实验中的用户输入.
这个实验是在Quen3-VL-8B上进行的,同时使用V-Lens和L-Lens.
对于视觉编码器,我们使用V-Lens来读取平均编码器补丁状态,对于语言解码器,我们使用L-Lens来读取平均解码器映像托肯状态.
连接器中,我们用与其中间状态相适应的透镜(Appendix A.1 )来读取平均视觉状态.
如第2.2节所述,我们在此采用中心战略,使这一概念更易于阅读(附录B.2)。

blocks.en:
For each image, we rank vocabulary tokens by their readout scores, and record the best rank among the complete single-token word forms of the target object’s name.
For example, if ␣Bicycle ranks 3 rd and ␣Bike ranks 7 th , we record rank 3.
We report the median of these ranks across images as the median target rank.
We also measure Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 , the percentage of images for which at least one of these tokens appears in the top-ten readout.
A lower median target rank and a higher Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 both indicate greater object-name readability.
blocks.zh:
对于每个图像,我们按其读出分数对词汇符号进行排序,并在目标对象名称的完整单键单词形式中记录最佳排名.
例如,如果QQ自行车排行榜第3位,QQ自行车排行榜第7位,我们记录了3位.
我们报告这些图像的中位数为中位目标数。
我们还测量了 Pass QQ@ @ 10\operatorname{ PassXXX10},其中至少一个符号出现在前十名读出时的图像百分比 。
一个较低的中位目标级别和一个更高的Pass QQ@@ 10\operatorname{PassXXX10 都表明对象名称的可读性更大.

blocks.en:
Figure 9 : Visual concept readout across network depth. Object-name readability in the centred mean visual state at each layer, without a text question, measured by (A) median target rank and (B) Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 .
Grey bands show 95% confidence intervals.
The darker blue region marks the estimated workspace (WS).
blocks.zh:
图9:整个网络深度的视觉概念读取。 每个层的中间平均视觉状态中对象名的可读性,没有文字问题,用(A)中位目标等级和(B)Pass QQ@@ 10\operatorname{PassQXX10 测量.
灰波段显示95%的置信间隔.
较深的蓝色区域标志着估计的工作空间(WS).

blocks.en:
As shown in Figure 9 (A,B), object-name readability improves towards the end of the encoder and remains at a similar level through the connector.
It drops at the start of the decoder and then improves again in later decoder layers.
The shaded region marks the estimated workspace, whose boundaries and interpretation are discussed in Section 6 .
In the later layers of the estimated workspace, the median target rank is better and Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 is higher than in the later encoder layers.
In the encoder, concepts in intermediate states are accessible using V-Lens and become more accessible with increasing depth.
In the decoder, even without a text question, we can still use L-Lens to access concepts from intermediate states at visual token positions, and accessibility increases substantially within the estimated workspace.
blocks.zh:
如图9(A,B)所示,对象名称的可读性在编码器的末端有所改进,并通过连接器保持类似水平.
它在解码器开始时下降,然后在后来的解码层中再次改进.
阴影区域标志着估计的工作空间,第6节讨论了其界限和解释。
在估计的工作空间的后层中,中位目标级别更好,而Pass QQ@ 10\operatorname{Pass}@10高于后期编码层.
在编码器中,中间状态中的概念使用V-Lens可访问,并随着深度的增大而更容易访问.
在解码器中,即使没有文字问题,我们仍然可以使用L-Lens在视觉符号位置上访问中间状态的概念,在估计的工作空间内访问量也大大增加.

blocks.en:
V-Lens can provide a spatial-level concept map.
Specifically, we apply V-Lens to individual image patches at encoder L18 and L25, using only the image as the user input in this experiment.
blocks.zh:
V-Lens可以提供空间级概念地图.
具体来说,我们在编码器L18和L25上将V-Lens应用到单个的图像补丁上,只使用图像作为这个实验中的用户输入.

blocks.en:
Example 3.3 illustrates two scenes. For each scene, we choose a set of object names and a separate set of attribute words: colours for the kitchen scene and material-related words for the desk scene.
We compare readout scores within each set and colour each patch by its highest-scoring word, producing separate object and attribute maps. Patches remain white if the winning word falls outside the top 10,000 tokens (cutoff).
blocks.zh:
例3.3说明了两个场景。 对于每个场景,我们选择一组物体名称和一组单独的属性词:厨房场景的颜色和办公桌场景与材料相关的词.
我们把每集内的读出分数和每块补丁以最高得分的单词进行对比,生成单独的对象和属性图. 如果胜出的单词落在前10000个令牌之外,补丁仍为白色(禁用).

blocks.en:
At L18, several objects are already distinguishable, but many patches remain white.
At L25, more patches have readable object names, and the arrangement of objects is clearer, especially in the desk scene.
In the kitchen scene, banana and apple mark the fruit on the left, and cup marks the mug on the right.
In the desk scene, book highlights the open pages, and interestingly, the pot region is labelled as cup at L18 but as plant at L25.
This change suggests that the concept readout can better match the object in the image at a deeper layer.
blocks.zh:
在L18,多个对象已经可以区分,但许多补丁仍然是白色的.
在L25中,更多的补丁具有可读对象名称,对象的安排更清晰,特别是在桌面场景中.
在厨房现场,香蕉和苹果标记左边的水果,杯子标记右边的杯子.
在桌上的场景中,书籍突出开放的页面,有趣的是,锅区在L18被标注为杯子,但在L25被标注为植物.
这一变化表明,概念读出可以在更深层上更好地匹配图像中的对象.

blocks.en:
The attribute maps show that these spatial readouts extend beyond object names.
In the kitchen scene, yellow and red coincide with the banana and apple, while blue identifies the bowl.
In the desk scene, glass highlights the bottle, and ceramic marks the cup.
Material readouts remain more scattered than the object and colour maps, and some labels extend beyond the corresponding objects.
blocks.zh:
属性图显示这些空间读取扩展超过对象名称.
在厨房的场景中,黄色和红色与香蕉和苹果同时出现,而蓝色则识别碗.
在桌上的场景中,玻璃突出瓶子,陶瓷标记了杯子.
材料读取仍然比对象和彩色地图更加分散,有些标签的扩展超出了相应的对象.

blocks.en: In this experiment, the concept maps generated by V-Lens allow us to examine the model’s understanding of multimodal information in intermediate states at a fine spatial scale, and to analyse it from different concept dimensions.
blocks.zh: 在这个实验中,由V-Lens生成的概念图使我们能够从细微的空间尺度来检查模型对中间状态的多式联运信息的理解,并从不同的概念维度来分析.

blocks.en: 4 Selective Access to Multimodal Concepts
blocks.zh: 4 选择获得多式联运概念

blocks.en:
An important feature described by GWT is that information generated simultaneously by different specialised processes competes for access to a shared workspace.
The selected information then becomes consciously accessible ( Baars and Franklin, 2007 ) .
In this section, we try to identify a similar selective access mechanism for multimodal concepts in the intermediate states of VLMs, supported by our proposed MC-Lens.
blocks.zh:
GWT描述的一个重要特征是,不同专门程序同时生成的信息争夺共享的工作空间。
然后,选定的信息可以自觉地获取(Baars和Franklin,2007年)。
在本节中,我们试图为自愿最低限值中间状态的多式联运概念确定一个类似的选择性准入机制,并得到我们提议的MC-Lens的支持。

blocks.en:
Specifically, we first examine how the text query affects concept accessibility in intermediate states, by changing the text query for a fixed image.
We then further track changes in concept accessibility during autoregressive generation.
Together, these experiments provide evidence for selective access to multimodal concepts in the intermediate states of VLMs.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,我们首先审查文本查询如何影响中间状态中的概念可访问性,方法是修改固定图像的文本查询。
然后,我们进一步跟踪在自动递减生成过程中概念无障碍性的变化。
这些实验共同提供了证据,证明在VLMs中间状态中有选择地使用多式联运概念.

blocks.en: 4.1 Query-Dependent Selective Access to Visual Concepts
blocks.zh: 4.1 对视觉概念的查询-依赖性选择访问

blocks.en: In this experiment, we investigate selective access to visual concepts through MC-Lens readouts and measure the relative accessibility of concepts in the same scene.
blocks.zh: 在这个实验中,我们通过MC-Lens读取对视觉概念的选择性访问进行调查,并测量同一场景中概念的相对可获取性.

blocks.en:
We collect 100 scene images from COCO ( Lin et al., 2014 ) .
For each image, we select three visible objects as the target concepts for our experiment and prepare one question for each object.
Each question identifies its target through colour, position, or a relation to other scene content, without naming it.
The VLM receives the same image and one question at a time, and we query each image three times using three different questions.
We apply L-Lens to the pre-answer position at each decoder layer of Qwen3-VL-8B, and record the ranks of all three target object-name tokens for comparison.
blocks.zh:
我们从COCO收集了100张场景影像(Lin等人,2014年).
对于每个图像,我们选择三个可见的物体作为我们实验的目标概念,并为每个物体准备一个问题.
每个问题通过颜色,位置,或者与其他场景内容的关系来识别其目标,而不命名.
VLM一次收到相同的图像和一个问题,我们用三个不同的问题来查询每个图像三次.
我们把L-Lens应用到每个解码层的Qwen3-VL-8B的预答位置,并记录所有三个目标对象名符号的等级,以便进行比较.

blocks.en: Input Input Image Query on Left Object “What object is on the left ? Answer with one word.” Query on Right Object “What object is on the right ? Answer with one word.”
blocks.zh: 在左侧对象上输入输入图像查询 “左边是什么物体? 用一个字回答。” 查询“右边是什么物体?” 以一个字答. “

blocks.en: L-Lens readout
blocks.zh: L - 灯光读出

blocks.en:
Finding: Within the estimated workspace, the query changes concept
readability for both objects and their associated attributes.
blocks.zh:
发现: 在估计的工作空间内,查询改变概念
对象及其相关属性的可读性。

blocks.en:
To measure “selectivity”, we define successful selection for a question as the requested object’s name token ranking above the name tokens of the other two objects.
Therefore, selective sensitivity can be defined as the percentage of images with successful selection under all three questions at the same decoder layer.
Higher values indicate more consistent query-dependent selection.
blocks.zh:
为了衡量“选择性”,我们将一个问题的成功选择定义为被请求对象的名称符号排名高于其他两个对象的名称符号。
因此,选择性灵敏度可以定义为在同一解码层的所有三个题下成功选择图像的百分比.
更高的数值表示更一致的依赖查询的选择.

blocks.en: To account for potential concept information introduced by the text question itself, we repeat the same questions with a uniform grey image (blank) to measure the contribution of visual evidence to selection.
blocks.zh: 为了说明文本提问本身所提出的潜在概念信息,我们用统一的灰色图像(blank)重复同样的问题,以衡量视觉证据对选择的贡献.

blocks.en:
Figure 10 : Query-dependent selection of visual concepts. Top: selective sensitivity for original images (Image) and uniform grey images (Blank).
Bands show 95% confidence intervals.
Bottom: Image minus Blank, in percentage points (pp).
blocks.zh:
图10:视觉概念依赖查询选择. 顶部:对原始图像(Image)和统一灰色图像(Blank)的选择性敏感性.
乐队显示95%的置信间隔.
下方:图像减去空白,以百分点计 (pp).

blocks.en:
As shown in the upper panel of Figure 10 , selective sensitivity remains close to zero in earlier decoder layers and rises sharply within the estimated workspace when the original image is provided.
With a grey image baseline, the increase is much smaller.
The lower panel shows the difference in selective sensitivity between Image and Blank, and this difference still becomes larger within the estimated workspace.
We find that the text query can substantially increase the relative accessibility of the corresponding concepts among the compared concepts in the same scene.
These results demonstrate that the text query can drive selective access.
blocks.zh:
如图10的上方面板所示,在早期的解码层中,选择性敏感性仍然接近于零,并在提供原始图像时,在估计的工作空间内急剧上升.
有了灰色图像基线,增幅要小得多.
较低的面板显示图像和空白之间选择性敏感度的差异,这种差异在估计的工作空间内仍然变大.
我们发现文本查询可以大大增加同一场景中比较概念中相应概念的相对可获取性.
这些结果显示文本查询可以驱动选择性访问.

blocks.en:
We also provide three examples to examine selective access to objects, their associated attributes and other scene content.
In Example 4.1 , we examine query-dependent selection of objects and their associated colours.
We use an image containing a blue cup on the left and a yellow book on the right, and alternate between questions about the left and right objects.
We compare the readability of cup , book , blue and yellow under the left-object query and the right-object query.
blocks.zh:
我们还提供了三个实例来审查有选择地访问物体、其相关属性和其他场景内容。
在例4.1中,我们审查对对象及其相关颜色的依赖查询选择。
我们使用的图像中,左边有蓝色的杯子,右边有黄色的书,关于左右物体的问题交替出现.
我们比较了左对象查询和右对象查询下的杯、书、蓝和黄的可读性。

blocks.en:
We can find that before the estimated workspace, concept accessibility under the two different queries is similar, with little separation between the queries.
In contrast, within the estimated workspace, the left-object question makes cup more readable than book , while the right-object question reverses this order.
Across much of the estimated workspace, the colour concept blue is also more readable under the left-object question and yellow under the right-object question.
Since neither question requests a colour, this change suggests that the selective access mechanism can extend beyond the answer name to an associated attribute, and this selective pattern becomes pronounced within the estimated workspace.
blocks.zh:
我们可以发现,在估计工作空间之前,两个不同查询下的概念无障碍性是相似的,查询之间几乎没有什么区分.
相比之下,在估计的工作空间内,左面对象问题使得杯比书更容易读取,而右面对象问题则颠倒了这个顺序.
在整个估计的工作空间中,颜色概念蓝色在左-对象问题下也更容易读取,在右-对象问题下则比较黄色.
由于两个问题都没有要求一种颜色,这一变化表明选择性访问机制可以超越答案名称延伸至关联属性,这种选择性模式在估计的工作空间中变得清晰.

blocks.en: Input Neutral Query “What do you see?” Foreground Query “What do you see in the foreground ?” Distance Query “What do you see in the distance ?” Input Image
blocks.zh: 输入中性查询 “你看到了什么?” 前景查询 “你在前面看到什么?” 距离查询 “你在远处看到什么?” 输入图像

blocks.en: L-Lens readout
blocks.zh: L - 灯光读出

blocks.en:
Finding: Under the distance query, tree reaches high ranks at shallower decoder layers than cat .
The query makes concepts from the requested region more readable, including concepts not named in the model’s answer.
blocks.zh:
发现 : 在距离查询下,树在比猫更浅的解码层达到高阶.
查询使请求区域的概念更易于读取,包括模型答案中未命名的概念。

blocks.en:
In Example 4.1 , we analyse the relationship between this selectivity and spatial relations.
Specifically, the example image contains a foreground dog and a distant cat beside a tree, and we keep the image fixed and use a neutral query, a foreground query and a distance query.
blocks.zh:
在例4.1中,我们分析这种选择性与空间关系之间的关系。
具体地说,示例图像包含一个前景犬和一个树旁的远方猫,我们保持图像固定,并使用中性查询,前景查询和距离查询.

blocks.en:
Within the estimated workspace, neutral and foreground questions make dog more readable than cat and tree , and the model answers “dog”.
The distance question instead makes both cat and tree more readable within the estimated workspace. Tree becomes highly readable at earlier decoder layers than cat , even though the model ultimately answers “cat”.
Under a neutral query, the visually prominent dog is more accessible.
When the text query specifies the distant region, it directs access towards cat and tree , even though the dog remains visually prominent in the image.
Similar to the previous example, this selective pattern becomes clearer within the estimated workspace.
blocks.zh:
在估计的工作空间内,中立和前景问题使狗比猫和树更容易读,模型回答“狗”。
相反,距离问题使得猫和树在估计的工作空间中更容易读取。 树在比猫更早的解码层变得非常易读,尽管模型最终会回答“猫”。
在中性查询下,视觉突出的狗更容易接触.
当文字查询指定了遥远的区域时,它引导访问面向猫和树,尽管狗在图像中仍保持视觉突出.
与前一个例子类似,这种选择性模式在估计的工作空间中变得更加清晰.

blocks.en: Input Input Image Direct Query “What object is on the left ? Answer with one word.” Ignore Query “ Ignore the book . Name the other object. Answer with one word.”
blocks.zh: 输入图像直接查询 “左边是什么物体? 用一个字回答。” 忽略查询“ 忽略本书 。 命名另一个对象。 以一个字答. “

blocks.en: L-Lens readout Model answer: “cup” under both queries
blocks.zh: L - 灯光读出 示范答复:两次查询下的“cup”

blocks.en:
Finding: The ignore instruction makes book less readable in the later layers, while cup remains highly ranked.
The query can change concept readability without changing the model’s answer.
blocks.zh:
发现 : 被忽略的指令使得书在后层的可读性更低,而杯子仍然处于高位.
查询可以改变概念可读性而不改变模型的答案.

blocks.en:
Example 4.1 provides another example of selective access, where we use a specific instruction to reduce access to a concept.
Specifically, we use the same cup/book image as Example 4.1 and compare a direct query with an instruction to ignore the book and name the other object.
The model answers “cup” under both queries.
blocks.zh:
例4.1提供了选择性访问的另一个例子,我们用具体指示减少对一个概念的访问。
具体来说,我们使用与例4.1相同的杯/书图像,并将直接查询与指示进行比较,以忽略该书并命名另一个对象.
该模型在两个查询中都回答“cup”。

blocks.en:
Within the estimated workspace, book has substantially lower readability under the ignore query, even though it is not included in either answer.
This shows that selective access can also affect concepts in intermediate states, even though they are not selected for output.
blocks.zh:
在估计的工作空间内,书在忽略查询下可读性要低得多,尽管没有包括在两个答案中。
这表明选择性访问也会影响中间状态中的概念,即使它们不是被选中用于输出.

blocks.en: 4.2 Selective Access during Autoregressive Generation
blocks.zh: 4.2 自动递归生成过程中的选择性访问

blocks.en:
We have examined selective access to visual concepts at the pre-answer position in the previous section.
Here, we extend the analysis to concept accessibility during autoregressive generation.
Specifically, we build two case studies of autoregressive rollout: identifying objects in spatial order and naming objects with or without skipping specified items.
blocks.zh:
我们在前一节的回答立场上审查了有选择地获取视觉概念的问题。
在这里,我们把分析扩大到自动递归生成过程中的概念无障碍。
具体地说,我们建立了两个自递式推出的案例研究:按照空间顺序识别物体,以及用或不跳过特定项目来命名物体。

blocks.en: Input Image
blocks.zh: 输入图像

blocks.en:
Query: “Describe exactly the three main objects in this image, from top to bottom , using one complete sentence.
Name each object once.
Do not use a list, numbering, or bullet points.”
blocks.zh:
查询 : “ 在此图像中准确描述三个主要对象, 从上到下, 使用一个完整的句子 。
命名每个对象一次。
不使用列表、编号或项目点。 “

blocks.en: Reading the heatmaps: The “vintage” column shows the readout just before the model generates ␣suitcase .
blocks.zh: 读取热图: “胜利”一栏显示,

blocks.en: L-Lens readout
blocks.zh: L - 灯光读出

blocks.en:
Finding: Before an object’s name is generated, its concept is usually more readable in the estimated workspace than in earlier decoder layers.
Immediately before generation, the name token reaches rank 1 in the motor layers.
Once the name enters the text prefix, the concept also becomes more readable in earlier layers.
blocks.zh:
查找:在生成对象名称之前,其概念在估计的工作空间中通常比早期的解码层更可读.
即时在一代之前,名称符符在运动层中达到一级.
一旦名称进入文本前缀,概念在更早的层中也变得更加可读.

blocks.en:
We first examine concept readability before and after an object’s name is generated during autoregressive generation.
In Example 4.2 , the image contains a kite, a cat and a suitcase, and we instruct the model to describe these objects from top to bottom in a single sentence.
blocks.zh:
我们首先审查在自动递归生成过程中生成物体名称之前和之后的概念可读性。
在例4.2中,图像包含风筝,猫和手提箱,我们指示模型在单句中描述这些物体从上到下.

blocks.en:
After the model generates its answer, we feed back successively longer prefixes of that answer, and use L-Lens to read the updated last token state at each decoder layer.
At each prefix, we read the same three target object-name tokens, i.e., ␣kite , ␣cat and ␣suitcase .
Each heatmap presents the accessibility of one object-name token, where columns show the state after each prefix-ending token, rows show decoder layers, and colour indicates vocabulary rank.
blocks.zh:
在模型生成其答案后,我们接连反馈该答案的较长前缀,并使用L-Lens读取每个解码层更新的最后一个符号状态.
在每一个前缀中,我们读到相同的三个目标对象名称符号,即QQkite,QQcat和QQsuitcase.
每个热映射可以显示一个对象名称符号的可访问性,其中列显示每个前缀结束符号后的状态,行显示解码层,颜色表示词汇等级.

blocks.en:
We can find that the three observed target concepts show similar selective access patterns.
Before each object-name token is generated, it is usually more readable in the estimated workspace than in earlier decoder layers, and immediately before generation it reaches rank 1 in the output-preparation (motor) layers.
However, once a name enters the text prefix, it is also more readable in earlier decoder layers.
For example, suitcase is already highly readable in the estimated workspace when the prefix ends in “green” and then “vintage”, before the model names the object.
In contrast, after “suitcase” enters the text prefix, it becomes more readable in the pre-workspace layers.
blocks.zh:
我们可以发现,观察到的三个目标概念显示出类似的选择性访问模式。
在每个对象名称符号生成之前,它通常比早期的解码器层在估计的工作空间中更容易读取,在生成之前,它就在输出-准备(motor)层中达到一级.
然而,一个名称一旦进入文本前缀,在早期的解码层中也更容易读取.
例如,当前缀以“绿色”结尾,然后在模型命名对象之前,手提箱在估计的工作空间中已经非常可读。
相比之下,在“succase”进入文本前缀之后,它就更容易在工作前层中读取。

blocks.en:
This example is also consistent with the sensory, workspace and motor organisation discussed in the J-Lens study ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
In our example, a concept becomes more readable in earlier layers once its name enters the input, and in motor layers just before its name is generated.
We interpret its earlier accessibility within the workspace as consistent with the concept being available for subsequent computation.
blocks.zh:
这个例子也符合J-Lens研究(Gurnee等人,2026年)中所讨论的感官、工作空间和运动组织。
在我们的例子中,一个概念在更早的层中,当它的名字进入输入时,就变得更容易被读取,在产生它的名字之前,它就在运动层中.
我们将其先前在工作空间内的可访问性解释为符合可供随后计算的概念。

blocks.en: Input Image
blocks.zh: 输入图像

blocks.en: Task: Name the objects in numerical order as a comma-separated list. Shared generated prefix: list: dog, apple, book, chair, car, candle, magnet Model continuation:
blocks.zh: 任务:按数字顺序将对象命名为逗号分隔列表。 共享生成的前缀:列表:狗,苹果,书,椅子,汽车,蜡烛,磁铁 模式延续:

blocks.en: Ascending order hammer, crown, camera …
blocks.zh: 升序锤,王冠,相机...

blocks.en: Skip 8 and 9 hammer , crown , camera …
blocks.zh: 跳过8和9锤,王冠,相机...

blocks.en: L-Lens readout
blocks.zh: L - 灯光读出

blocks.en: Finding: Changing the output instructions changes concept accessibility within the estimated workspace, even when the image and the generated prefix are the same.
blocks.zh: 发现:修改输出指令会改变估计工作空间内的概念可访问性,即使图像和生成的前缀是相同的.

blocks.en:
We next examine the effect of the text instructions on concept accessibility during autoregressive generation.
In Example 4.2 , we use an image with 16 objects in a specific order, and the query is to report these items following this order.
In a second condition, we ask the model to skip some of these objects, specifically “hammer” and “crown”.
During autoregressive rollout, the generated prefixes are identical through the first seven object names, ending with “magnet”.
And in the normal ascending run, the next required name is “hammer”, while in the skip run it is “camera”.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来审查文本指示在自动生成过程中对概念无障碍性的影响。
在例4.2中,我们使用一个带有16个对象的图像,按照一个特定的顺序,查询就是按照这个顺序报告这些项目.
在第二个条件下,我们要求模型跳过其中一些物体,特别是“危险”和“克隆”。
在自动回转推出时,产生的前缀通过前七个对象名称是相同的,以“磁铁”结尾。
在正常的上升运行中,下一个需要的名称是“hammer”,而在跳转运行中则是“camera”。

blocks.en:
Similar to the previous example, concepts become more readable within the estimated workspace before their names are generated, and in earlier layers once their names enter the input.
This experiment shows that changing the text instructions also leads to the change in concept accessibility within the estimated workspace, even when the image and the generated prefix are the same.
blocks.zh:
与前一个例子类似,概念在生成名字之前,在估计的工作空间内,以及在较早的层中,一旦名字输入输入,概念就更容易被读取.
这个实验显示,修改文本指令也会导致估计工作空间内的概念无障碍性发生变化,即使图像和生成的前缀是相同的.

blocks.en: 5 Causal Effects of Multimodal Concepts on Downstream Reasoning
blocks.zh: 5 多式联运概念对下游的因果关系

blocks.en:
The previous sections showed that concepts can be selectively accessed in intermediate states, but these observations do not explain how the model uses the information.
In GWT, the selected information in the shared workspace can be available to other specialised processes, which allows this information to influence more than one computation ( Baars and Franklin, 2007 ) .
In this section, we use the counterfactual interventions defined in Section 2.4 to examine the effects of concept-related state components on the final outputs of the model, as illustrated in Figure 11 .
blocks.zh:
前几节显示,概念可以在中间状态中选择性地访问,但这些观察并不能解释模型如何使用信息.
在GWT中,共享工作空间中选定的信息可以提供给其他专门程序,这使得这些信息能够影响一个以上的计算(Baars和Franklin,2007年)。
在本节中,我们利用第2.4节界定的反事实干预来审查与概念相关的国家组成部分对模型最后产出的影响,如图11所示。

blocks.en: Figure 11 : Counterfactual interventions on concept representations. (A) Replacing country-related components can change the answer to a capital question. (B) Four intervention operators and their state updates. (C) Necessity and sufficiency tests replace and restore components using original and grey-image states.
blocks.zh: 图11:关于概念表述的反事实干预。 (A) 替换与国家有关的部分可以改变对死刑问题的答案。 (B) 四个干预操作员及其状态更新。 (C) 使用原始和灰色图像状态替换和恢复组件。

blocks.en: 5.1 Counterfactual Concept Interventions Can Redirect Downstream Reasoning
blocks.zh: 5.1 反事实概念干预可重新引导下游理性

blocks.en:
In this experiment, we examine the effects of concept-related state components on model answers under the settings of direct and one-hop VQA tasks.
In this setting, the concept c 1 c_{1} is identified from the image, and c 2 c_{2} is an associated concept, as illustrated in Figure 11 (A).
We intervene on the state components associated with c 1 c_{1} and compare a question about c 1 c_{1} (direct intervention) with a question about c 2 c_{2} (one-hop intervention).
blocks.zh:

For the quantitative analysis, we build source-to-target pairs using the 50 national-flag images from Noto Color Emoji and follow the same intervention procedure as in Example 5.1 .

We compare the name-token set F 0 F_{0} with broader word-form sets and greedy sets with different direction budgets.
Each direction set is used with SubRep and AbIn , alongside the F 0 + PairSwap F_{0}+\texttt{PairSwap} baseline.
For the one-hop task, capital-answer tokens are excluded during greedy selection.

blocks.en:
For both direct and one-hop tasks, different intervention operators and direction sets lead to diverse effects on model answers.
As shown in Figure 12 (A), direct interventions with SubRep redirect nearly every answer across all tested direction sets.
The name-token set F 0 F_{0} therefore already provides strong control in the direct task, and expanding this set brings only limited improvement.
In contrast, the success of one-hop interventions varies much more with the direction set, as shown in Figure 12 (D).
With SubRep fixed, broader word-form sets F ≤ j F_{\leq j} improve one-hop intervention success, but the greedy sets J ​ @ ​ k J@k are more effective.
Even the smallest greedy set, J ​ @ ​ 5 J@5 , redirects nearly every one-hop answer, whereas the broadest word-form set, F ≤ 3 F_{\leq 3} , redirects fewer than half. J ​ @ ​ 5 J@5 gives stronger one-hop control with fewer directions per concept, using five compared with roughly eight for F ≤ 3 F_{\leq 3} .

名称-token集F 0 F_{0}因此已经为直接任务提供了强大的控制,扩展这个集只能带来有限的改进.

blocks.en:
We also find that answer control depends on the intervention operator.
With the same name-token set F 0 F_{0} , SubRep and AbIn redirect more direct answers than PairSwap , as shown in Figure 12 (A). SubRep maintains high success across the greedy budgets in both direct and one-hop tasks, while AbIn ’s success falls as the set expands (Figure 12 (A,D)).
The vocabulary ranks help explain these different answer outcomes.
For one-hop interventions, target answers remain near the top of the vocabulary with SubRep , but become less readable as the greedy budget increases with AbIn , as shown in Figure 12 (E).
At the same time, AbIn suppresses source answers more strongly in Figure 12 (F).
Suppressing the source is therefore insufficient for reliable redirection when the target also loses accessibility.
blocks.zh:
我们还发现,答案控制取决于干预操作者。
如图12(A)所示,使用同名调制的F 0 F_{0},SubRep 和 AbIn 重定向比 PairSwap 更直接的答案. SubRep在直接任务和一跳任务中都保持了贪婪预算的高度成功,而AbIn的成功则随着套件的扩展而下降(图12(A,D))。

同时,AbIn压制源解答在图12(F)中更为强烈.
因此,当目标也失去可获取性时,对源的压制不足以可靠地改变方向。

blocks.en:
Generally speaking, these experiments show that concept information identified through MC-Lens can contribute to downstream computation in both direct and one-hop tasks.
The effects depend on both the selected concept directions and the intervention operator.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,这些实验表明,通过MC-Lens识别的概念信息可以在直接和一跳任务中促进下游计算.
效果既取决于选定的概念方向,也取决于干预操作者。

最宽的字形集F 3 F_{\leq 3}也恢复了每一个答案.

这意味着,在大多数选中的组件对原始答案是必要的例子中,它们也足以在灰映射运行中恢复答案.

blocks.en:
For one-hop interventions, NR remains close to zero with the word-form sets F ≤ j F_{\leq j} , and even the broader sets rarely recover the answer, as shown in Figure 13 (D,E).
The greedy sets J ​ @ ​ k J@k are much more effective at recovering answers, and recovery improves markedly with the greedy budget.
However, even J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 and J ​ @ ​ 35 J@35 disrupt only a small minority of the original answers.
For example, one-hop J ​ @ ​ 35 J@35 interventions recover about 85% of answers, but the selected components are both necessary and sufficient in only 15% of examples, as shown in Figure 13 (E,F).
blocks.zh:
就一跃式干预而言,NR仍然接近于零,单词形式是F ≤ j F_{\leq j},甚至更广义的组合也很少恢复答案,如图13(D,E)所示.
贪婪者设置的J@kJ@k在恢复答案方面要有效得多,而随着贪婪的预算的出现,复苏明显改善.
然而,即使是J@25 J@25和J@35 J@35也只干扰了一小部分最初的答案.
例如,如图13(E,F)所示,1-hop J@35J@35的干预恢复了约85%的答案,但仅在15%的例子中,选定的组件既必要又足够。

blocks.en:
Generally speaking, the selected concept-related components can support downstream computation.
As the reasoning chain extends from direct to one-hop, the selected components show lower NR and SR, even with broader direction sets.
For one-hop tasks, most recovered answers do not also pass the necessity test, suggesting that other components may also support the original answers.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,选定的概念相关组件可以支持下游计算.
由于推理链从直接延伸至单跳,所选组件显示的NR和SR较低,甚至有更广泛的方向集.
对于一跳任务,大多数恢复的答案没有也通过必要性测试,暗示其他组件也可能支持原始答案.

blocks.en: 5.3 Causal Effects of Concepts across Various Downstream Reasoning Tasks
blocks.zh: 5.3 各种下游任务概念的因果关系

blocks.en:
In this part, we examine how an accessed concept can serve as shared intermediate information for different downstream tasks.
In a one-hop VQA task ( I → c 1 → c 2 → A I\rightarrow c_{1}\rightarrow c_{2}\rightarrow A ), we keep the input image I I and the initial concept c 1 c_{1} fixed, and vary the downstream question to ask about different concepts c 2 c_{2} associated with c 1 c_{1} .
Here, A A is the model’s answer.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们审查一个可获取的概念如何作为不同下游任务的共享中间信息。
在单跳 VQA 任务( I → c 1 → c 2 → A I\rightarrow c_{1 → rightarrow c_{2 → rightarrow A ) 中,我们保留输入图像 I 和初始概念 c 1 c_{1 } 并更改下游问题,以询问与 c 1 c_{1 相关的不同概念 c 2 c_{2 } 。
在这里,A是模型的答案。

blocks.en:
Specifically, as Example 5.3 illustrates, we extend the downstream task from identifying the capital to questions about the three-letter country code (ISO-3), currency code and other associated information.
We then change the country-related components from Ireland to Tunisia using J ​ @ ​ 25 + SubRep J@25+\texttt{SubRep} on Qwen3-VL-8B, and observe the changes in the model’s answers across these tasks.
We find that the capital answer changes from “Dublin” to “Tunis”, and the currency code changes from “EUR” to “TND”.
Four of the six answers change to their targets, but the domain and calling-code answers remain non-target outputs.
blocks.zh:
具体地说,如例5.3所示,我们把下游任务从确定首都扩大到关于三字母国家代码(ISO-3)、货币代码和其他相关信息的问题。
然后,我们利用Qwen3-VL-8B上的J@25+SubRep J@25+texttt{SubRep}将与国家有关的组件从爱尔兰更改为突尼斯,并观察模型对这些任务的答案的变化。
我们发现,首都答案从“杜布林”改为“图尼斯”,货币编码从“欧元”改为“TND”。
6个答案中有4个改变了他们的目标,但域和呼叫码答案仍然是非目标产出.

blocks.en:
For the quantitative analysis, we build 51 eligible source-to-target pairs using the same 50 national-flag images from Noto Color Emoji, with tasks covering the country name, ISO-3 code, capital, currency code, continent, internet domain and calling code.
We apply SubRep in all decoder layers of Qwen3-VL-8B, using the name-token set F 0 F_{0} , broader word-form sets F ≤ j F_{\leq j} and greedy sets J ​ @ ​ k J@k , with FullRep as a reference.
Downstream-answer tokens are excluded during greedy selection.
We measure target-answer rate to evaluate intervention success, as in Section 5.1 .
blocks.zh:
为了量化分析,我们利用来自Noto Color Emoji的50幅国家国旗图像,构建51对符合条件的源对目标,任务涵盖国名,ISO-3代码,资本,货币代码,大陆,互联网域名和呼叫代码.
我们在Qune3-VL-8B的所有解码层中应用SubRep,使用名调集F 0 F_{0},广义的单词形式集F≤j F_{\leq j}和贪婪的集J@k J@k,以FullRep作为参考.
下游的答题符号在贪婪的选择时被排除在外.
正如第5.1节所述,我们衡量目标答复率,以评估干预成功与否。

blocks.en: Figure 14 : The same concept directions influence answers across tasks. We compare target-answer rates for SubRep using different concept direction sets, with FullRep as a control.
blocks.zh: 图14:同一概念方向影响各种任务的答案. 我们使用不同的概念方向集来比较SubRep的目标解答率,FullRep作为控制.

blocks.en:
As illustrated in Figure 14 , direct interventions succeed in nearly every case for all direction sets, whereas the success of one-hop interventions varies more.
For the one-hop tasks, F 0 F_{0} and F ≤ 1 F_{\leq 1} give similar target-answer rates, while the broader word-form sets improve control.
All three greedy sets give higher target-answer rates than the word-form sets on these tasks.
blocks.zh:
如图14所示,在所有方向组合中,直接干预几乎在每一种情况下都取得成功,而一次性干预的成功程度则不同。
对于单跳任务,F 0 F_{0}和F≤1 F_{\leq 1}给出相似的目标解答率,而广义的单词形式集则改善了控制.
所有三个贪婪的组合给出的目标解答率都高于这些任务的单词形式组合.

blocks.en:
The larger greedy sets redirect most answers across the one-hop tasks, with further improvements as the greedy budget increases.
Calling codes remain less reliably redirected even with the largest greedy set, while FullRep reaches every target on every task.
blocks.zh:
更大的贪婪者将大多数答案重新用于一跳任务,随着贪婪者预算的增加而进一步改善。
调用代码仍然不可靠 重新定向 即使最贪婪的一组, 而FullRep 达到每个任务的目标。

blocks.en:
Generally speaking, these experiments show that the same concept directions can influence answers across different downstream tasks, providing functional evidence for the broad availability of concept information described by GWT ( Baars and Franklin, 2007 ) .
The stronger control obtained with broader direction sets suggests that they capture more of the concept-related information used across these tasks.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,这些实验表明,同样的概念方向可以影响不同下游任务的答案,为GWT描述的概念信息的广泛提供提供提供功能证据(Baars and Franklin, 2007.).
通过更广泛的方向集获得的更强有力的控制表明,它们捕捉到更多贯穿这些任务的概念相关信息。

blocks.en: 5.4 Causal Effects of Concepts on Multi-Hop Reasoning
blocks.zh: 5.4 概念对多重理由的因果关系

blocks.en:
In this part, we further extend the direct and one-hop comparisons in Section 5.1 to multi-hop tasks.
In these questions, the input identifies an initial concept c 1 c_{1} , which is linked through an intermediate concept c 2 c_{2} to a final concept c 3 c_{3} asked about in the question.
We compare interventions on c 1 c_{1} -related components alone with joint interventions on c 1 c_{1} - and c 2 c_{2} -related components, and measure the resulting changes in the final answer A A .

在这一部分中,我们进一步将第5.1节中的直接比较和一跳比较扩大到多跳任务。
