blocks.en:
Example 5.4 shows an intervention for a question about the administrative division containing the capital of the country shown by a flag.
The source relation links the country Canada ( c 1 c_{1} ) to its capital Ottawa ( c 2 c_{2} ) and then Ontario ( c 3 c_{3} ), while the target relation links Greece to Athens and then Attica .
With the Canadian flag and question unchanged, a J ​ @ ​ 25 + SubRep J@25+\texttt{SubRep} intervention on country-related components changes the answer from “Ottawa, Ontario” to “Athens, Attica”.
blocks.zh:
例5.4显示了对包含国旗显示的国家首都的行政区划问题的干预.
来源关系将加拿大(c 1 c_{1})与首都渥太华(c 2 c_{2})和安大略(c 3 c_{3})联系起来,而目标关系则将希腊与雅典和阿提卡联系起来。
由于加拿大国旗和问题不变,关于国家相关部分的J@25+SubRep J@25+\texttt{SubRep}发言将答案从“安大略渥太华”改为“雅典、阿提卡”。

blocks.en:
Example 5.4 shows an unsuccessful case, where we apply the same type of intervention to a question about the International Air Transport Association (IATA) code of an international passenger airport serving the capital.
With country-related components changed from Denmark to Jamaica , the answer changes from “CPH” to “SIN”, missing the target airport code “KIN”.
blocks.zh:
例5.4显示了一个不成功的事例,即我们对服务于首都的国际客运机场的国际航空运输协会(空运协会)代码问题采用同样的干预方式。
由于与国家有关的构成部分从丹麦改为牙买加,答案从“CPH”改为“SIN”,没有目标机场代码“KIN”。

blocks.en:
For the quantitative analysis, we use 40 eligible multi-hop cases from the same national-flag image set, covering six types of questions about the capital.
These questions concern administrative divisions, rivers, airport codes, railway stations, national legislatures and metro opening years.
We follow the same intervention procedure as in Example 5.4 and compare F 0 F_{0} , F ≤ 2 F_{\leq 2} and J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 via SubRep under the two intervention conditions ( c 1 c_{1} and c 1 + c 2 c_{1}+c_{2} ).
We use the concept directions for c 1 c_{1} alone or the combined direction sets for c 1 c_{1} and c 2 c_{2} to replace the corresponding state components.
Final-answer tokens are excluded during greedy selection.
We include FullRep as a control and use the same eligible cases for all comparisons.
blocks.zh:
为了进行定量分析,我们使用同一国家旗图集的40个符合条件的多跳案件,涵盖了6类关于首都的问题.
这些问题涉及行政区划,河流,机场代码,火车站,国家立法机关和地铁开业年.
我们遵循与例5.4相同的干预程序,并在两个干预条件(c 1 c_{1}和c 1 + c 2 c_{1 + c_{2})下,通过SubRep,将F 0 F_{0}、F 2 F_{\leq 2}和J@25 J@25 J@25通过SubRep进行比较。
我们只使用c 1 c_{1}或c 1 c_{1}和c 2 c_{2}的组合方向来替换相应的状态组件.
在贪婪的选择过程中,最后的回答符号被排除在外.
我们把FullRep作为控制对象,并在所有比较中使用相同的合格案例.

blocks.en: Figure 15 : Country and capital interventions in multi-hop questions. We compare final-answer outcomes between country-only interventions ( c 1 c_{1} ) and combined country and capital interventions ( c 1 + c 2 c_{1}+c_{2} ) using SubRep , with FullRep as a control.
blocks.zh: 图15:多跳题的国家和资本干预。 我们利用SubRep(以FullRep为控制手段),将国别干预(c 1 c_{1})和综合国家干预和资本干预(c 1 + c 2 c_{1}+c_{2})之间的最后答案结果进行比较。

blocks.en:
Figure 15 reports the proportions of target final answers, source final answers and other answers, based on the complete generated answers.
The experiment shows that multi-hop interventions on c 1 c_{1} alone can redirect the final answer.
Broadening the word-form set from F 0 F_{0} to F ≤ 2 F_{\leq 2} increases the share of target final answers, but J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 is more effective than either word-form set and leaves fewer answers at the source fact.
blocks.zh:
图15根据完整生成的答案,报告目标最终答案,源最终答案和其他答案的比例.
实验显示,单在c 1 c_{1}上的多跳干预可以重定向最终答案.
将设定的字形从F 0 F_{0}扩展为F 2 F_{\leq 2}增加了目标最终答案的比重,但J@25 J@25比两个字形集更有效,在源代码中留下的答案较少.

blocks.en:
In addition, joint interventions ( c 1 + c 2 c_{1}+c_{2} ) increase the target-answer rate for every direction set compared with interventions on c 1 c_{1} alone.
As a control, FullRep replaces the whole internal state and reaches every target answer.
In these multi-hop tasks, interventions on c 1 c_{1} -related components can therefore redirect the final answer, and additional interventions on c 2 c_{2} -related components improve control.
blocks.zh:
此外,联合干预(c 1 + c 2 c_{1}+c_{2})提高每个方向的目标回答率,而仅C 1 c_{1 的干预就提高了目标回答率。
作为控制,FullRep取代整个内部状态,并达到每个目标答案.
在这些多跳任务中,对c 1 c_{1} 相关组件的干预因此可以重新定向最终答案,对c 2 c_{2} 相关组件的额外干预则可以改善控制.

blocks.en:
To sum up, our experiments show that the concept information accessed through MC-Lens is not merely shown on a “display board”, but also participates in downstream computation and reasoning.
These effects across direct, one-hop and multi-hop tasks provide functional evidence for the downstream availability of concept information described by GWT ( Baars and Franklin, 2007 ) .
blocks.zh:
总之,我们的实验表明,通过MC-Lens获取的概念信息不仅显示在“显示板上”,而且还参与下游的计算和推理。
这些跨直接、一跳和多跳任务的影响为GWT描述的概念信息的下游提供提供了实用证据(Baars和Franklin,2007年)。

blocks.en: 6 Global Workspace Structure and Function across VLMs
blocks.zh: 6 全球工作空间结构与职能,涉及自愿参与活动

blocks.en:
Previous sections have shown that multimodal concepts can be read from intermediate states, selectively accessed in response to queries, and used in downstream computations, providing evidence for the functions described by GWT ( Baars, 2005 ) .
In this section, we investigate the structural and functional organisation of global workspaces in VLMs.
blocks.zh:
前几节表明,多式联运概念可以从中间状态读取,有选择地用于回答询问,并用于下游计算,为GWT描述的函数提供证据(Baars,2005年)。
在本节中,我们调查全球工作空间在VLM的结构和功能组织。

blocks.en: 6.1 Shared Workspace Structure across Model Families
blocks.zh: 6.1 模范家庭的共享工作空间结构

blocks.en:
In this part, we investigate shared global workspace structures by comparing J-space geometry and prediction agreement across Qwen3-VL (2B, 8B, and 32B) ( Bai et al., 2025 ) , DeepSeek-VL2 (Tiny, Small, and full) ( Wu et al., 2024 ) , and Gemma 3 (4B, 12B, and 27B) ( Gemma Team, 2025 ) .
Vocabulary-direction geometry and effective dimensionality describe the organisation of the directions used for concept readout at each layer.
Prediction agreement measures whether the model’s final predicted token is already readable from an intermediate state.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们通过比较Qwen3-VL(2B、8B和32B)的J-空间几何和预测协议来调查共享的全球工作空间结构。 (Bai等人,2025年),DeepSeek-VL2 (Tiny, Small, and full)(Wu等人,2024年),和Gemma 3(4B,12B,27B). (Gemma Team, 2025).
词汇-方向几何和有效维度描述每一层概念读取所用的方向的组织.
预测协议衡量模型的最终预言符号是否已经可以从中间状态读取.

blocks.en:
Figure 16 : J-space geometry across nine VLMs. Heatmaps compare vocabulary-direction geometry across layers and components using CKA.
Curves show the fraction of state dimensions needed to retain 90% of the energy in the centred vocabulary directions.
Blue brackets and darker blue shading mark the estimated workspace.
blocks.zh:
图16:跨越9个VLM的J-空间几何. 海atmaps使用CKA来比较跨层和组件的词汇方向几何.
曲线显示在中心词汇方向中保留90%能量所需的状态维度的一小部分.
蓝括号和较深的蓝色阴影标记了估计的工作空间.

blocks.en:
We first compare the layerwise organisation of vocabulary directions across models, following the J-Lens analysis ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
We use linear centred kernel alignment (CKA) ( Kornblith et al., 2019 ) to measure how similar the relationships among these directions are between layers.
Higher CKA appears as brighter blocks and indicates more similar direction relationships.
We also evaluate the spread of vocabulary directions using Direction dimension ratio@90%.
This is the fraction of state dimensions needed to retain 90% of the energy in the centred vocabulary directions.
A higher ratio indicates that these directions are spread over more state dimensions.
blocks.zh:
我们首先根据J-Lens分析(Gurnee等人,2026年),对跨模型词汇方向的分层组织进行比较。
我们使用线性中心内核对齐(CKA)(Kornblith等人,2019年)来测量这些方向间的关系如何相似.
较高的CKA显示为更亮的块,并显示更相似的方向关系.
我们还利用方向尺寸比@90%来评价词汇方向的分布.
这是将90%的能量保留在核心词汇方向上所需的状态维度的一小部分.
较高的比率表明,这些方向分布在更多的状态维度.

blocks.en: Among these models, we also estimate the workspace intervals marked in the figures from direction geometry and dimensionality, together with the layerwise readout profiles (Appendix A.4 ).
blocks.zh: 在这些模型中,我们还估计了从方向几何和维度数字中标出的工作空间间隔,以及分层读取剖面图(附录A.4 ).

blocks.en:
In Qwen and DeepSeek, early decoder layers have relatively similar direction geometries.
At later layers, their geometries become more differentiated, as seen in the decoder blocks of Figure 16 (A-C,G-I) .
Gemma retains high similarity across much more of the decoder, as shown by the CKA matrices in Figure 16 (M-O).
The separation between depth regions resembles the sensory, workspace and motor organisation described by Gurnee et al. (2026) .
These regions are associated with input processing, the selection and use of intermediate concepts, and preparation of the output, respectively.
Appendix B.1 shows that the broad layerwise organisation in Qwen3-VL-8B is preserved across fitting-set sizes.
blocks.zh:
在Quen和DeepSeek中,早期的解码层有相对相似的方向几何.
在后来的地层中,它们的几何变异性变得更强,如图16的解码块(A-C,G-I)所见.
如图16(M-O)中的CKA矩阵所示,Gemma在更多的解码器中保持高度相似性。
深度区域之间的分离类似于Gurnee等人(2026年)描述的感官、工作空间和运动组织。
这些区域分别与输入处理,中间概念的选择和使用以及产出的准备有关.
附录B.1显示,Qune3-VL-8B中的大层次组织保存在装配的大小之间。

blocks.en:
In Qwen and DeepSeek, the dimension-ratio curves in Figure 16 (D-F,J-L) rise more sharply around the estimated workspace entry.
The start of this rise indicates the transition into the estimated workspace more clearly than the broad regions of high similarity in the CKA matrices.
As processing moves through this interval, vocabulary directions spread over more state dimensions.
In Gemma, the dimension ratios remain low through much of the decoder: 4B and 27B rise mainly near the output, while 12B remains low throughout, as shown in Figure 16 (P-R).
blocks.zh:
在Quen和DeepSeek中,图16(D-F,J-L)中的维度-拉特曲线围绕估计的工作空间条目上升得更明显.
这一增长的开始表明向估计工作空间的过渡比CKA矩阵中高度相似的广泛区域更为明显。
随着处理通过这个间隔移动,词汇方向分散在更多的状态维度.
在Gemma,通过大部分解码器,维度比仍然很低:4B和27B主要在产出附近上升,而整个12B仍然很低,如图16(P-R)所示.

blocks.en:
Across models, encoder dimension ratios remain relatively low.
The vision encoders differ in their layerwise direction geometry, both across model families and within the same family.
In some encoders, a boundary in the CKA matrix is accompanied by an increase in the dimension ratio, as in DeepSeek-VL2 Small (Figure 16 (H,K)).
In others, such as Gemma 3 12B, the CKA matrix shows less distinct layer separation and the dimension ratio stays low (Figure 16 (N,Q)).
blocks.zh:
在各种模型中,编码器尺寸比率仍然较低。
视觉编码器在分层方向几何方面,无论是在模范家庭之间还是在同一个家庭内部,都有所不同.
在一些编码器中,CKA矩阵中的边界伴随着维度比的提高,如DeepSeek-VL2 Small(图16(H,K)).
在其他情况下,如Gemma 3 12B,CKA矩阵显示的分层分离较少,尺寸比保持低(图16(N,Q)).

blocks.en:
Direction geometry describes the fitted lens, but does not tell us when the eventual output token becomes accessible for a particular input.
We therefore compare the pre-answer readout at each decoder layer with the model’s own final prediction on 100 image-question inputs from A-OKVQA ( Schwenk et al., 2022 ) , following the layerwise agreement analysis of the J-Lens study ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
For each input, we take the model’s highest-scoring token at the final layer and check whether it appears among the top eight tokens read out from each intermediate layer.
Agreement@8 is the percentage of inputs that satisfy this condition at a given layer.
Higher values indicate that the final predicted token is more consistently accessible from the intermediate readout.
blocks.zh:
方向几何描述装配的镜头,但不告诉我们最终的输出符何时可以被特定输入.
因此,我们将每个解码层的预答读数与模型本身对A-OKVQA(Schwenk等人,2022年)的100个图像问题输入的最后预测进行比较,这是在对J-Lens研究(Gurnee等人,2026年)进行分层协议分析之后进行的。
对于每个输入,我们在最后一层取模型的最高评分符号,并检查它是否出现在从每个中间层读出的八大符号中。
协议@8 是在某一层中满足此条件的投入百分比.
较高的数值表明,从中间读取中可以更一致地获取最终预测的符号.

blocks.en: Figure 17 : Prediction agreement across nine VLMs. Agreement@8 is the percentage of inputs for which the model’s highest-scoring token at the final layer appears among the top eight tokens in the intermediate readout.
blocks.zh: 图17:9个自愿终止妊娠的预测协议。 Agreement@8是该模型在最后一层最高评分符号在中间读出中前八位符号中显示的输入百分比.

blocks.en:
The Agreement@8 curves in Figure 17 remain low at early depths and rise mainly within the estimated workspace intervals across all nine models.
Gemma also shows a sharp rise in Agreement@8, although its decoder direction geometry is less differentiated (Figures 16 (M-O) and 17 (G-I)).
This highlights the need to consider multiple indicators when estimating workspace boundaries.
blocks.zh:
图17中的“协定@8”曲线在早期深度仍然很低,主要在估计工作空间间隔内在所有9个模型中上升。
Gemma还显示出协议@8的急剧上升,尽管其解码器方向几何的区别较小(图16(M-O)和图17(G-I))。
这突出了在估计工作空间界限时需要考虑多种指标。

blocks.en: Across these models, the final predicted token becomes more readable within the estimated workspace, often alongside changes in direction geometry.
blocks.zh: 在这些模型中,最后的预测符号在估计的工作空间中更易读取,往往伴随着方向几何变化。

blocks.en: 6.2 Shared Workspace Functions across Model Families
blocks.zh: 6.2 模范家庭共享工作空间功能

blocks.en:
In this part, we investigate shared global workspace functions across VLMs with different layerwise organisations.
We compare concept accessibility, query-dependent selection and downstream use across the nine models.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们调查了不同层层组织在甚高频上共享的全球工作空间功能。
我们比较了9个模型的概念无障碍性,依赖查询选择和下游使用.

blocks.en:
We first compare concept accessibility from visual states across network depth without a specific text query.
We conduct the object readout experiments of Section 3.3 across nine models.
The median-rank and Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 curves in Figure 18 track changes in object-name readability.
blocks.zh:
我们首先比较整个网络深度的视觉状态的概念无障碍性,而没有具体的文本查询.
我们用9个模型进行第3.3节的读物实验。
图18 对象名称可读性轨迹变化图中的中位数排名和 Pass QQ@ 10\operatorname{PassQX10 曲线.

blocks.en:
Figure 18 : Object-name readout across nine VLMs. Median target rank and Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 track readability from centred mean visual states without a question.
Grey bands show 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh:
图18:9个VLM上的对象名称读出. Mediden目标级别和Pass QQ@@ 10\operatorname{PassQQ10轨道可读性从中间的平均值状态读出,没有问题.
灰波段显示95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en:
Across most models, object-name readout improves remarkably within the estimated workspace.
In some models, including Qwen8B and 32B, readability already increases towards the end of the encoder, then falls at the start of the decoder before rising again.
In Qwen and Gemma, decoder readouts improve within the estimated workspace and exceed those in the encoder, as seen in the rank and Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 curves in Figure 18 (A-F,M-R).
This improvement within the estimated workspace is shared despite differences in direction geometry.
blocks.zh:
在大多数模型中,对象名称读出在估计的工作空间中显著改善。
在包括Qune8B和32B在内的一些型号中,可读性已经接近编码器的末端增加,然后在解码器开始时下降,然后再次上升.
在Quen和Gemma中,解码器读数在估计的工作空间内有所改进,并超过了编码器中的读数,如排名和Pass QQ#@10\operatorname{PassXXX10曲线图18(A-F,M-R)所示.
尽管在方向几何上存在差异,但估计工作空间内的这一改进是共同的。

blocks.en:
The main exceptions are DeepSeek Small and Full, shown in Figure 18 (H,I,K,L).
Small remains weak throughout, while Full improves within the estimated workspace but falls sharply in the final few decoder layers.
blocks.zh:
主要例外是DeepSeek Small and Full,如图18(H,I,K,L)所示.
小部分在总体上仍然薄弱,而在估计的工作空间内完全改善,但在最后几层解码层则急剧下降。

blocks.en:
We next compare concept accessibility and query-dependent selection across the nine models, following the settings in Sections 3.1 and 4.1 .
We measure Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 for concept accessibility and selective sensitivity for query-dependent selection.
Higher Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 indicates better readability of the target answer token, while higher selective sensitivity indicates more consistent selection under all three questions about each image.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们按照第3.1节和4.1节的设置,在9个模型中比较概念的可获取性和依赖查询的选择。
我们测量 Pass QQ@ @ 10\operatorname{ PassQX10 用于概念可访问性,并选择对查询依赖的选择的敏感度。
高传QQ@ 10\ operatorname{ PassQX10 表示目标答案符的可读性更好,而更高的选择性灵敏度则表示在每张图像的所有三个问题下更一致的选择.

blocks.en:
Figure 19 : Answer readout and query-dependent selection across nine VLMs. (A-I) Answer-token Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 with image evidence. (J-R) Selective sensitivity, the percentage of images with successful selection under all three questions at the same decoder layer.
Difference is the image-minus-blank gap in percentage points.
Grey bands show 95% confidence intervals.
blocks.zh:
图19:9个VLM的回答读出和依赖查询的选择. (A-I) Answer-token Pass QQ@@10\operatorname{PassQX10 带有图像证据. (J-R) 选择性灵敏度,在同一解码层的所有三个题下成功选择图像的百分比.
差异是图像-减去-空白的百分点差距。
灰波段显示95%的置信间隔.

blocks.en:
Across all three model families, answer readout remains low in early decoder layers and increases mainly within the estimated workspace, as shown in Figure 19 (A-I).
Query-dependent selection also improves within this region, as shown in panels (J-R).
Image input produces a much larger increase in selection than a blank image, indicating that the questions select information supplied by the scene.
blocks.zh:
如图19(A-I)所示,在所有三个模式家庭中,早期解码层的解码读数仍然很低,主要在估计工作空间内增加。
如板块(J-R)所示,依赖查询的选择也改进了本区域内部的情况。
图像输入产生比空白图像更大的选择量,表明问题选择了场景提供的信息.

blocks.en:
We then jointly analyse each model’s best-layer answer readout and query-dependent selection in Figure 20 (A). 8 8 8 The measurements use different image sets and may peak at different layers. Points towards the upper right indicate stronger answer readout and more reliable selection, while those towards the lower left indicate weaker performance on both.
The within-family trajectories in Figure 20 (A) move towards the upper right as model size increases in Qwen and Gemma, combining stronger answer readout with more reliable query-dependent selection.
DeepSeek also moves up and right from Tiny to Small, but the move from Small to Full is mainly rightward, with better readout and the same selection peak.
Qwen lies above Gemma at comparable readout levels, indicating that similar answer accessibility can accompany different selection success.
blocks.zh:
然后,我们在图20(A)中共同分析每个模型的最好层次的答案读出和依赖查询的选择。 8 8 测量使用不同的图像集,可能在不同层上达到峰值。 右上角的点表示更强的答案读出和更可靠的选择,而左下角的点则表示两者的性能都较弱.
图20 (A)中的家庭内部轨迹随着昆文和Gemma的模型大小增加而向右上移,结合了更强的答案读取和更可靠的依赖查询的选择.
DeepSeek也从Tiny向上和向右移动,但从Small向Full的移动主要是向右移动,有更好的读取和相同的选择高峰.
Quen位于Gemma之上的可比读出级别,表明相似的答案可访问性可以伴随不同的选择成功.

blocks.en:
Figure 20 : Readout, selection and downstream effects across nine VLMs. (A) Best-layer answer-token Pass ⁡ @ ​ 10 \operatorname{Pass}@10 and selective sensitivity. (B-D) NR, SR and NSR for capital answers, using J ​ @ ​ 25 + SubRep J@25+\texttt{SubRep} on country-related components. (E-G) Cross-task target-answer rates using SubRep with three concept direction sets for the country.
In (A-D) , dashed lines connect models within each family.
blocks.zh:
图20:9个甚高频的读取、选择和下游效应。 (A) 最佳级的答题卡通QQ@@ 10\ 操作器名{ PassQX10 和选择性敏感度。 (B-D)NR,SR和NSR用于资本答案,使用J@25+SubRep J@25+\texttt{SubRep}在国家相关组件上. (E-G)跨任务目标解答率使用SubRep为国家设置三个概念方向集.
在(A-D)中,破折线连接每个家族内的模型.

blocks.en:
Across model families, answer readout and query-dependent selection both strengthen within the estimated workspace.
Larger models generally achieve stronger answer readout and more reliable selection, but models with similar answer readout can differ in selection success.
blocks.zh:
在整个模范家庭,在估计的工作空间内,答案读取和依赖查询的选择都得到加强。
较大模型一般能实现更强的答案读出和更可靠的选择,但具有类似答案读出模式在选择成功方面可能有所不同.

blocks.en:
We next examine the necessity and sufficiency of selected intermediate concept components for downstream reasoning, following the experimental setting in Section 5.2 .
All nine models are required to answer capital-identification questions on national-flag images from Noto Color Emoji.
We apply one-hop interventions to the country-related state components along the concept directions of the greedy set J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 .
As in Section 5.2 , both tests apply the do \operatorname{do} intervention for SubRep in Equation 26 .
Following the definitions in Section 5.2 , higher NR indicates greater dependence on the accessed concept information in downstream computation.
Higher SR indicates that this information is more often sufficient to produce the correct downstream answer.
Higher NSR indicates that the accessed concept information is more often both necessary and sufficient for the correct downstream answer.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们根据第5.2节的实验设置,审查下游推理的选定中间概念组成部分的必要性和充分性。
所有9个模型都被要求回答来自诺托彩色Emoji的国家旗图像上的资本识别问题.
我们沿着贪婪的J@25J@25的概念方向,
同第5.2节一样,这两种测试都应用了在方程式26中子Rep的 do\peratorname{do}干预.
遵照第5.2节中的定义,较高的NR表示在下游计算中更多地依赖已获取的概念信息。
较高级的SR表示,这些信息更经常地足以得出正确的下游答案.
更高的NSR表示,获取的概念信息对于正确的下游答案来说更是必要和充分。

blocks.en:
Across all three families, NR decreases as model size increases, indicating that fewer original answers depend on the selected country-related components (Figure 20 (B)).
However, SR increases with model size in Gemma and DeepSeek but decreases in Qwen (Figure 20 (C)).
Thus, lower necessity in larger models is a shared pattern, while changes in sufficiency differ across model families.
blocks.zh:
在所有三个家庭中,NR随着模型大小的增加而减少,表明依赖选定的国家相关组成部分的原始答案较少(图20(B))。
然而,SR随着Gemma和DeepSeek的模型大小而增加,但在Quen却减少(图20(C)).
因此,较大模型中较低的必要性是一种共同的模式,而模型家庭在充足性方面的变化则有所不同。

blocks.en:
In every model, NSR remains below SR (Figure 20 (C,D)).
This means that the selected components can be sufficient to recover the correct answer without being necessary for the original answer, with this pattern particularly pronounced in the larger Gemma and DeepSeek models.
blocks.zh:
在每一种模式中,NSR仍然低于SR(图20(C,D))。
这意味着所选的组件可以足以恢复正确答案而不需要原答案,这种模式在更大的Gemma和DeepSeek模型中特别显著.

blocks.en:
We finally extend the cross-task intervention experiment of Section 5.3 to all nine models to examine the downstream use of the same concept directions across tasks.
Within each model, we keep the concept directions for the country fixed across the seven questions.
We compare F 0 F_{0} , F ≤ 2 F_{\leq 2} and J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 using target-answer rates.
blocks.zh:
我们最终将第5.3节的跨任务干预实验扩大到所有9种模式,以审查同一概念方向在下游跨任务使用的情况。
在每个模式中,我们始终将国家的概念方向固定在七个问题上。
我们比较F 0 F_{0},F 2 F_{\leq 2}和J @ 25 J@25,使用目标回答率.

blocks.en:
The J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 profiles in Figure 20 (G) generally extend further outwards than the word-form profiles in panels (E) and (F).
Expanding from F 0 F_{0} to F ≤ 2 F_{\leq 2} increases the mean target-answer rate across the seven tasks in every model, and J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 raises it further.
With J ​ @ ​ 25 J@25 , larger models generally achieve stronger control, although increasing model size does not always improve the target-answer rate.
These experiments therefore show that, within each model, the same concept directions can influence answers across different downstream tasks.
The stronger control obtained with direction sets extending beyond concept names suggests that they capture more of the concept-related information used across these tasks.
blocks.zh:
图20(G)中的J@25 J@25配置图一般比面板(E)和(F)中的单词格式配置图进一步向外延伸.
从F 0 F_{0}扩展至F 2 F_{\leq 2}提高每个模型七个任务的平均目标回答率,J@25 J@25进一步提高.
有了J @ 25 J@25,更大的模型一般会实现更强的控制,尽管不断增大的模型尺寸并不总是能提高目标答案率.
因此这些实验表明,在每个模型中,相同的概念方向可以影响不同下游任务的答案.
通过超越概念名称的方向集获得的更强有力的控制表明,它们捕捉到更多贯穿这些任务的概念相关信息。

blocks.en:
Generally speaking, these VLMs share patterns of concept accessibility and query-dependent selection within the estimated workspace.
The accessed concept information can also contribute to different downstream computations.
These shared functions are observed across models with different internal workspace structures.
These findings provide functional evidence for the selective access and broad availability of concept information described by GWT.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,这些VLM在估计的工作空间内共享概念可访问性和依赖查询的选择模式.
获得的概念信息也有助于不同的下游计算。
这些共享的功能在具有不同内部工作空间结构的模型中被观察到.
这些结论为有选择地获取和广泛提供GWT所述的概念信息提供了实用证据。

blocks.en: 7 Cross-Modal Concept Alignment and Selective Access during Learning
blocks.zh: 7 学习期间跨模块概念对齐和选择性访问

blocks.en:
Our experiments so far have examined concept accessibility and downstream effects in pre-trained VLMs with well-developed cross-modal alignment.
In this section, we aim to investigate how cross-modal concept alignment and a selective access mechanism develop during training.
To build a simple experimental setting, we connect a frozen CLIP vision encoder ( Radford et al., 2021 ) to a frozen Gemma language decoder ( Gemma Team, 2024 ) through a randomly initialised multilayer perceptron (MLP) connector.
We train the connector on an image-caption prediction task for vision-language alignment, while keeping the vision encoder and language decoder frozen, as in the feature-alignment stage of LLaVA ( Liu et al., 2023 ) (Appendix A.5 ).
By examining different training checkpoints, we can track the development of cross-modal concept alignment and selective access.
blocks.zh:
我们迄今为止的实验研究了概念的可获取性和在经过预先培训的具有完善的跨模式组合的VLM中的下游效应。
在本节中,我们的目的是调查在培训期间如何发展跨模式概念统一和选择性准入机制。
为了建立简单的实验环境,我们通过随机隐蔽的多层知觉(MLP)连接器将冷冻的CLIP视觉编码器(Radford等人,2021年)与冷冻的Gemma语言解码器(Gemma Team,2024年)连接起来.
我们训练连接器进行视觉语言对齐的图像封装预测任务,同时保持视觉编码器和语言解码器的冻结,如LLaVA(Liu等人,2023年)(附录A.5.
通过检查不同的培训检查站,我们可以跟踪跨模式概念的调整和选择性准入的发展情况。

blocks.en: 7.1 Tracking Cross-Modal Concept Alignment during Training
blocks.zh: 7.1 跟踪培训期间跨模式概念的调整

blocks.en:
In this part, we use MC-Lens to analyse cross-modal concept alignment during VLM training.
We develop two metrics, J-state cosine and reconstruction coverage (ReconCov), to measure cross-modal concept correspondence.
These metrics use concept directions to focus the analysis on information associated with a specific concept.
We then evaluate how well these metrics track cross-modal concept alignment during training.
blocks.zh:
在这一部分中,我们利用MC-Lens在VLM培训期间分析跨模式概念的配合.
我们制定了两个衡量标准,即J-状态余弦和重建覆盖(ReconCov),以衡量跨模式概念的对应性。
这些衡量标准利用概念方向将分析的重点放在与具体概念有关的信息上。
然后,我们评价这些衡量标准在培训期间如何跟踪跨模式概念的协调统一。

blocks.en:
J-state cosine measures the similarity between image and text states through their inner products with the same concept directions, as illustrated in Figure 21 (B).
Specifically, let h ~ I \widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{I}} and h ~ T \widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{T}} be the centred mean states for an image input and a text input naming the concept, respectively. 9 9 9 States are averaged over the input positions at the same decoder layer. We follow the reference centring in Section 2.2 . For each state, we take its inner product with every column of B B , the matrix of unit concept directions defined in Section 2.3 .
We compute the cosine between the resulting vectors B ⊤ ​ h ~ I B^{\top}\widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{I}} and B ⊤ ​ h ~ T B^{\top}\widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{T}} : s J = cos ⁡ ( B ⊤ ​ h ~ I , B ⊤ ​ h ~ T ) . s^{J}=\cos\!\left(B^{\top}\widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{I}},B^{\top}\widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{T}}\right). (32) The resulting J-state cosine ranges from − 1 -1 to 1 1 .
Values closer to 1 1 indicate more similar patterns of inner products, values near 0 0 indicate orthogonal patterns, and values near − 1 -1 indicate opposing patterns.
For comparison, we apply hidden state cosine as a baseline ( Shukor and Cord, 2024 ) , which compares the centred states directly without selecting concept directions in J-space: s H = cos ⁡ ( h ~ I , h ~ T ) . s^{H}=\cos\!\left(\widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{I}},\widetilde{h}_{\mathrm{T}}\right). (33)
blocks.zh:

The proposed J-state cosine and ReconCov measure different aspects of cross-modal concept correspondence, so their raw scores cannot be compared directly to determine which metric performs better.
In this part, we want to compare their ability to distinguish images of a given concept from images of other concepts.

在这一部分中,我们要比较它们区分特定概念的图像和其他概念的图像的能力.

blocks.en:
Specifically, for each concept, we calculate every image’s score for that same concept using each metric.
We then compare the scores of images depicting this concept with those of images depicting other concepts.
For example, when evaluating kayak , kayak images should receive higher scores for this concept than images of other objects, such as blenders and cellphones.
If a metric gives similarly high scores to both groups, it does not distinguish the concept well.
We use changes in this concept discrimination during training to evaluate the metrics’ ability to reflect the development of cross-modal concept alignment.

例如,在评价皮划艇时,皮划艇图像应比诸如搅拌机和手机等其他物体的图像获得更高的分数。
如果一个衡量标准给予两个组的同样高的分数,它并不能很好地区分这一概念。
在培训期间,我们利用这一概念中的歧视变化来评估衡量标准反映跨模式概念协调发展的能力。

blocks.en: 7.2 Development of Selective Access during Training

blocks.en:
Our earlier experiments showed selective access to visual concepts in trained VLMs.
Here, we use checkpoints from the same controlled training run to examine how this ability develops during vision-language alignment.
blocks.zh:
我们早先的实验显示,在经过训练的VLM中,有选择地获得视觉概念.
在这方面,我们利用同一受管制训练的检查站来审查这种能力在视线语言调整期间如何发展。

blocks.en:
Example 7.1 pairs a fixed image of a cup on the left and a book on the right with questions asking for either object.
At each checkpoint, we read both object names from the pre-answer decoder state and record their best ranks across complete single-token word forms.
We compare these ranks under the two questions to examine question-dependent selection.

我们比较这两个问题下的这些等级,以审查与问题有关的选择。

blocks.en: 8 Discussion
blocks.zh: 8 讨论情况

blocks.en:
Concept readouts beyond verbalisation. In this paper, we propose MC-Lens, which allows us to read verbalised concepts from intermediate visual and language states.
However, reading a concept “name” gives only a limited description of the corresponding concept representation.
In this paper, we extend this description to include word-form sets F ≤ j F_{\leq j} and greedy sets J ​ @ ​ k J@k .
Counterfactual experiments also show that interventions on intermediate states using a set of concept directions change one-hop and multi-hop answers more reliably than those using only the vocabulary direction of a single name token.
blocks.zh:
概念朗读,超越口头。 在本文中,我们提出MC-Lens,它使我们能够从中间视觉和语言状态读取口头化的概念.
然而,读取“名称”的概念只能有限地描述相应的概念表述。
在本文中,我们扩展这一描述,以包括文字形式F ≤ j F_{\leq j}和贪婪的设定J@k J@k.
反事实实验还显示,使用一组概念方向对中间状态的干预会比仅使用单一名称符号的词汇方向更可靠地改变一跳和多跳答案.

blocks.en:
These extensions broaden the description of a concept, but they still use the model’s language vocabulary.
For example, object names and attribute words give only a partial description of an object’s shape, texture and other visual details.
blocks.zh:
这些扩展拓宽了对一个概念的描述,但它们仍然使用模型的语言词汇.
例如,对象名称和属性词只给出了对对象形状,纹理和其他视觉细节的部分描述.

blocks.en:
This motivates future work on concept readouts that express concept information directly through multimodal representations, alongside or instead of words.
For example, images, video and audio could provide readouts of content that is difficult to verbalise.
Such readouts could help us study the representation, selection and use of this information in subsequent computation.
blocks.zh:
这促使今后就概念读物开展工作,这些概念读物直接通过多式联运表达方式,连同或代替文字表达概念信息。
例如,图像、视频和音频可以提供难以口头宣读的内容。
这种读取可以帮助我们研究这种信息在以后的计算中的代表性、选择和使用。

blocks.en:
Multimodal concept processing and GWT. With our proposed MC-Lens, we examine the relationship between multimodal concept processing in VLMs and GWT ( Baars, 2005 ) .
Our experiments show that multimodal concept information can be selectively accessed in intermediate states and can influence downstream computation across tasks.
These patterns appear across model families and provide functional evidence for the selective access and downstream availability of information described by GWT.
blocks.zh:
多式联运概念处理和GWT。 根据我们提议的MC-Lens,我们审查了VLMs和GWT的多式联运概念处理之间的关系(Baars,2005年)。
我们的实验表明,多式联运概念信息可以在中间状态中有选择地获取,并且可以影响跨任务的下游计算。
这些模式出现在模范家庭中,为有选择地获取和下游提供GWT所描述的信息提供了实用证据。

blocks.en:
However, our results do not yet identify the mechanisms for broadcasting selected multimodal information to different downstream processes, which is a central property of GWT ( Baars, 2005 ) .
Future work could trace selected information through downstream computations and test the pathways supporting its use.
As GWT seeks to explain conscious access, studying these mechanisms in LLMs and VLMs could contribute to research on machine consciousness ( Dehaene et al., 2017 ; Butlin et al., 2023 ) .
blocks.zh:
然而,我们的成果尚未确定向不同下游进程广播选定多式联运信息的机制,而下游进程是GWT的中心财产(Baars,2005年)。
今后的工作可以通过下游计算追踪选定信息并测试支持其使用的途径。
随着GWT试图解释自觉获取,研究LLMs和VLMs中的这些机理可以有助于机器意识的研究(Dehaene等人,2017年;Butlin等人,2023年).

blocks.en:
J-space constraints for cross-modal alignment. In Section 7.1 , we use J-space metrics to measure the development of concept-wise vision-language alignment during training.
These metrics could also serve as additional constraints during training.
blocks.zh:
跨模式对齐的J-空间限制. 在第7.1节中,我们使用J-空间度量法来衡量培训期间概念视觉语言协调的发展情况。
这些衡量标准也可能成为培训过程中的额外制约因素。

blocks.en:
For example, an auxiliary loss could encourage image and text states expressing the same concept to respond similarly along its concept directions at the same decoder layer.
Future work could combine this objective with token prediction and test its effects on concept alignment, query-dependent selection and downstream task performance.
blocks.zh:
例如,一个辅助损失可以鼓励表达相同概念的图像和文本状态在同一个解码层上按其概念方向作出类似反应.
今后的工作可以将这一目标与象征性预测结合起来,并测试其对概念调整、依赖查询的选择和下游任务业绩的影响。

blocks.en: 9 Related Work
blocks.zh: 9 相关工作

blocks.en: 9.1 Global Workspace Theory
blocks.zh: 9.1 全球工作空间 理论

blocks.en:
In an experiment on human visual attention, observers watched a video of two teams passing basketballs and counted the passes made by one team.
During the video, a person in a gorilla suit walked among the players.
Surprisingly, many observers failed to notice the gorilla ( Simons and Chabris, 1999 ) .
Global workspace theory offers an explanation for such failures of conscious perception ( Baars, 2005 ) .
In GWT, specialised processors carry out operations such as detecting motion and recognising objects.
These processors work in parallel, and their outputs compete for access to a shared workspace with limited capacity.
The workspace briefly holds the selected content and broadcasts it to all processors across the whole system, including those involved in memory, language and action ( Baars and Franklin, 2007 ) .
Global workspace theory associates conscious access with this broadcast.
In the “basketball and gorilla” example, the counting task gives greater priority to information about the attended team’s passes in the competition for workspace access.
Information about the gorilla may lose this competition and remain outside the workspace.
Without being broadcast, the gorilla information remains unavailable for conscious report, and the observer fails to notice the gorilla.
blocks.zh:
在一次关于人类视觉关注的实验中,观察者观看了两支球队通过篮球的视频,并统计了一支球队的通行证.
在视频拍摄期间,一名身着大猩猩服的人在玩家中间走过.
令人惊讶的是,许多观察者未能注意到大猩猩(Simons and Chabris, 1999).
全球工作空间理论为这种意识感知的失败提供了解释(Baars,2005年)。
在GWT中,专门的处理器进行诸如探测运动和识别物体等操作.
这些处理器平行工作,其产出竞争进入一个能力有限的共享工作空间。
工作空间简短地保存了选定的内容,并广播给整个系统的所有处理者,包括那些参与记忆、语言和行动的人(Baars和Franklin,2007年)。
全球工作空间理论将自觉访问与这个广播联系起来.
在 " 篮球和大猩猩 " 的例子中,计票任务在工作空间准入的比赛中更优先考虑关于参加比赛的球队通行证的信息。
有关大猩猩的信息可能会输掉这场比赛,留在工作空间之外.
没有播出,大猩猩信息仍然无法有意识地报告,观察者没有注意到大猩猩.

blocks.en:
The global neuronal workspace model ( Dehaene et al., 1998 ) explains GWT’s selection and broadcast mechanisms in terms of neural activity in the human brain.
This model proposes a network of neurons distributed across several cortical regions and linked by long-range connections.
The network receives signals from specialised processors and sends feedback to amplify or suppress their activity. Dehaene and Naccache (2001) elaborated the conditions for conscious access.
They emphasised that a representation must be amplified and sustained through interactions with workspace neurons to become available to multiple processes, including perceptual categorisation, long-term memory, evaluation and intentional action. Dehaene et al. (2003) further simulated two visual targets presented in quick succession.
The first target could prevent the second from triggering ignition , a sudden transition from an early sensory response to sustained activity across the workspace.
The model predicted that the second target would tend to be either unseen or clearly seen, consistent with the two peaks observed in human observers’ visibility ratings ( Dehaene et al., 2003 ) .
blocks.zh:
全球神经工作空间模型(Dehaene等人,1998年)从人类大脑神经活性的角度解释了GWT的选择和广播机制.
这个模型提出一个分布在几个皮层区域并通过远程连接连接的神经元网络.
网络接收专业处理器的信号,并发送反馈来扩大或压制其活动. Dehaene和Naccache(2001年)阐述了自觉进入的条件。
他们强调,必须通过与工作空间神经元的相互作用来扩大和保持一种表达方式,使之可用于多种过程,包括概念分类、长期记忆、评价和有意行动。 Dehaene等人(2003年)进一步模拟了两个快速连续呈现的视觉目标.
第一个目标可以防止第二个目标引发点火,即从早期感官反应突然过渡到整个工作空间的持续活动。
该模型预测,第二个目标往往不为人知或明显可见,这与人类观察员可见度评级中观察到的两个高峰是一致的(Dehaene等人,2003年)。

blocks.en:
Global workspace theory has also helped advance research on machine consciousness. Blum and Blum (2022) formalised GWT’s selection and broadcast mechanisms in the Conscious Turing Machine (CTM), an explicit computational model of consciousness.
In this model, long-term memory (LTM) consists of many specialised processors, each with its own memory.
A processor submits information as a chunk, a short message containing its content and an assigned importance.
Short-term memory (STM) serves as the shared workspace and holds one chunk at a time.
The Up Tree selects a winning chunk through successive pairwise competitions, and chunks with higher competition scores are more likely to advance.
The winning chunk enters STM, and the Down Tree broadcasts it to all LTM processors.
The authors also used the “basketball and gorilla” example ( Simons and Chabris, 1999 ) to illustrate this process.
The instruction to count one team’s passes is first broadcast to all processors.
The visual processors then give greater priority to information about that team.
The gorilla chunk has little chance of entering STM and being broadcast, so the CTM fails to consciously notice the gorilla ( Blum and Blum, 2022 ) .
The CTM gives GWT a precise computational formulation, with explicit rules for competition, storage and broadcast.
blocks.zh:
全球工作空间理论也帮助推进了机器意识的研究. Blum和Blum(2022年)在意识图灵机(CTM)中正式确定了GWT的选用和广播机制,这是意识的明确计算模型.
在这个模型中,长期记忆(LTM)由许多专业的处理器组成,每个都有自己的记忆.
处理器将信息作为一个块、包含其内容的短信息以及指定的重要性提交。
短期内存(STM)作为共享的工作空间,一次持有一个块.
Up Tree通过连续的对等比赛选择一个获胜的块,竞争分数较高的块则更可能晋级.
获胜的块进入了STM,"下树"将它广播给所有LTM处理器.
提交人还用“篮球和大猩猩”的例子(1999年,西蒙斯和查布里斯)来说明这一进程。
首先向所有处理者播送一个小组的通行证。
然后视觉处理器更优先处理有关该团队的信息。
大猩猩块几乎没有机会进入STM和被播出,因此CTM未能自觉地注意到大猩猩(Blum和Blum,2022年).
CTM给予GWT精确的计算公式,对竞争,存储和广播有明确的规则.

blocks.en:
Beyond formal accounts of consciousness, GWT has also inspired neural network architectures that use shared workspaces to coordinate information processing. Goyal et al. (2022) added a few shared memory slots to Transformers to coordinate information across input positions.
Representations at different positions compete for write access, and each position reads the selected information to update its state.
This design improved performance on visual reasoning tasks. VanRullen and Kanai (2021) proposed a shared latent workspace to connect separately trained vision, language and other networks.
The workspace would translate selected information from one network into representations usable by the other networks, implementing broadcast across modalities.
To reduce dependence on paired image-text data, Devillers et al. (2025) trained mappings between frozen vision and language networks through a shared workspace.
They also trained the mappings to reconstruct each representation after translation to the other modality and back, which allowed learning from unpaired data and reduced the number of paired examples needed for alignment and translation. Fountas et al. (2026) built an explicit workspace, the Global Key-Value Workspace, into pretrained LLMs.
Their method selects components from the key-value cache, writes them to the workspace and broadcasts the result back to all components.
Their experiments showed improved reasoning performance, and selecting fewer components preserved much of the performance of full broadcast at lower computational cost.
blocks.zh:
除了对意识的正式叙述外,GWT还激发了利用共享工作空间协调信息处理的神经网络架构. Goyal et al. (2022)在变形器上增加了几个共享的内存槽,以协调跨输入位置的信息.
不同位置的表示力竞相进行写入访问,每个位置读取所选信息以更新状态.
这种设计提高了视觉推理任务上的性能. VanRullen和Kanai(2021年)提议建立一个共同的潜在工作空间,以连接单独培训的愿景、语言和其他网络。
工作空间将把一个网络的某些信息转换成可供其他网络使用的陈述,实施跨模式的广播。
为了减少对配对的图像文本数据的依赖,Devillers等人(2025年)通过共享的工作空间对冷冻视觉和语言网络之间的绘图进行了培训.
他们还对绘图进行了培训,以在翻译到另一种方式和返回之后重建每个表述方式,从而可以学习未经解释的数据,并减少对齐和翻译所需的对齐实例。 Fountas等人(2026年)将一个明确的工作空间,即全球钥匙-Value工作空间,建设成预先训练的LLMS.
他们的方法从密钥值缓存中选择组件,将其写入工作空间,并将结果广播回所有组件.
他们的实验显示推理性能有所改善,选择较少的组件以较低的计算成本保留了大部分的全播性能.

blocks.en:
Another line of research examines the emergence of workspace-like organisation through LLM training.
To study information integration, Urbina-Rodriguez et al. (2026) measured synergy between attention heads, which is information that the heads carry only in combination, not individually.
They identified a synergistic core in the middle layers of trained models, absent in randomly initialised models.
The ablation of high-synergy heads disproportionately impaired mathematical reasoning.
Reinforcement learning restricted to these heads also produced larger gains than training redundant or randomly selected heads. Gurnee et al. (2026) developed J-Lens to investigate global workspace structure and function in LLMs.
They compared J-space geometry across layers using CKA and examined concept readouts and representational capacity.
These analyses identified an intermediate band of layers with coherent concept representations and limited capacity.
Within this band, MLP layers amplified J-space directions far more strongly than random directions.
A subset of attention heads relayed J-space content across token positions.
Both findings are consistent with GWT’s broadcast mechanism.
To study concept availability during reasoning, Chun et al. (2026) measured how easily the model’s internal states could be separated according to the value of an intermediate variable.
The states were easy to separate while the model computed the variable and again when a later step used it.
In between, they were much harder to separate, although trained probes could still recover the variable’s value.
The authors interpreted this pattern as the allocation of limited representational capacity to the current computation.
In this paper, we extend this line of work to visual concepts in VLMs, examining selective access to these concepts under different questions and their availability to multiple downstream computations.
blocks.zh:
另一行研究是通过LLM培训来研究工作空间类组织的出现。
为了研究信息整合,Urbina-Rodriguez等人(2026年)测量了注意力头之间的协同效应,这是头部只携带组合,而不是单独携带的信息.
他们确定了在训练有素的模型中层的协同核心,随机公布的模型中没有这种核心。
高协同头部的衰减对数学推理造成了不成比例的损害.
仅限于这些头部的强化学习也比训练多余或随机挑选的头部产生更大的收益. Gurnee等人(2026年)开发了J-Lens,调查LLMs中的全球工作空间结构和功能.
他们利用CKA对各层的J-空间几何进行了比较,并审查了概念读取和代表能力。
这些分析确定了一组中间层,概念表述一致,能力有限。
在这个波段内,MLP层放大J-空间方向比随机方向强得多.
一组注意头将J空间内容转发到符号位置。
这两项调查结果都符合GWT的广播机制.
为了在推理过程中研究概念的可用性,Chun等人(2026年)根据中间变量的值,测量了该模型的内部状态如何容易分离.
这些州很容易分离,而模型则计算变量,然后在后一步使用变量时再次计算。
在两者之间,它们更难分离,尽管训练有素的探测器仍然可以恢复变量的价值。
提交人将这一模式解释为将有限的代表能力分配给目前的计算。
在本文中,我们把这项工作扩展到VLMs中的视觉概念,审查在不同的问题下有选择地获取这些概念,以及这些概念可用于多个下游计算.

blocks.en: 9.2 Mechanistic Interpretability
blocks.zh: 9.2 机械解释

blocks.en:
A model’s final answer provides only a limited view of its internal concept representations.
To study these representations, researchers have developed methods for reading information from intermediate states. Alain and Bengio (2016) introduced linear classifier probes, training a separate classifier on each layer’s activations while keeping the original network fixed.
To discover features beyond predefined categories, Bricken et al. (2023) used a sparse autoencoder to decompose activations in a one-layer language model.
This revealed features for specific text patterns, and activating selected features steered generation towards the corresponding patterns.
Another way to read an intermediate state is to express its content through the model’s own vocabulary.
The Logit Lens ( nostalgebraist, 2020 ) applies the model’s output mapping directly to each layer’s hidden states to track token predictions across layers.
The Tuned Lens ( Belrose et al., 2023 ) first applies a learned transformation specific to each layer.
Its readouts more closely match the model’s final token probabilities.
Patchscopes ( Ghandeharioun et al., 2024 ) inserts a hidden state into a decoding prompt and lets the model generate a description of its content.
blocks.zh:
模型的最后答案只提供了对其内部概念表述的有限看法。
为了研究这些表述,研究人员制定了从中间状态读取信息的方法. Alain和Bengio(2016年)引入了线性分类器探测器,在每层激活时训练一个单独的分类器,同时保持原有的网络固定.
为了发现超出预定义类别的特征,Bricken等人(2023年)使用稀疏的自动编码器在单层语言模型中分解激活.
这揭示了特定文本模式的特征,激活了选定的特征,引导生成到相应的模式。
另一种读取中间状态的方法是通过模型本身的词汇来表达其内容.
Logit Lens(怀旧代数学家,2020年)将模型的输出映射直接应用到每个层的隐藏状态,以跟踪跨层的符号预测.
Tuned Lens (Belrose et al., 2023) 最早应用了每一层特有的学习转化.
它的读数更接近于模型的最终征兆概率.
补丁镜(Ghandeharioun et al., 2024)将隐藏状态插入解码提示器中,让模型生成对其内容的描述.

blocks.en:
Vocabulary readouts can also be constructed from the model’s Jacobians, which describe how changes in intermediate states affect its output. Hernandez et al. (2024) proposed the Attribute Lens to read attributes from entity representations.
They constructed a mapping by averaging Jacobians over examples of the same relation, such as musician-instrument pairs, allowing trumpet to be recovered from the representation of Miles Davis . Gurnee et al. (2026) applied the same averaging principle across prompts and token positions to construct J-Lens for reading concepts across contexts.
J-Lens maps intermediate states into the final layer’s representation space and applies the model’s output mapping, revealing intermediate concepts omitted from answers in multi-hop reasoning.
To further reduce noise in the averaged Jacobian, Yan et al. (2026) retained only the pairs of token positions with the largest Jacobian norms.
Keeping the top 20% improved intermediate-concept recall on five of six tasks in Qwen3-8B.
To improve readouts in early layers, Blank et al. (2026) introduced R-Lens, replacing ordinary gradients with coefficients computed using layer-wise relevance propagation.
This reduced irrelevant tokens in the readouts and revealed some intermediate concepts earlier than J-Lens.
blocks.zh:
词汇读数也可以从模型的雅各比人中构建出来,其中描述了中间状态的变化如何影响它的输出. 赫尔南德斯等人(2024年)提议Atpition Lens来读取实体代表物中的属性.
他们用平均的雅各比亚人来绘制一个地图, 上面有相同关系的例子, 例如音乐家-仪器配对, Gurnee等人(2026年)在各种提示和象征性立场中采用了同样的平均原则,构建了各种背景概念的J-Lens。
J-Lens将中间态映射到最后一层的表示空间,并应用模型的输出映射,揭示了在多跳推理中解答时省略的中间概念.
为了进一步减少平均雅各比亚语中的噪声,颜等人. (2026年)仅保留了具有最大雅各比亚规范的对象征位置.
在Qune3-8B的6项任务中,保持前20%改进的中间概念召回。
为了改进早期层的读取,Blank等人(2026年)引入了R-Lens,用利用层层相关性传播计算的系数取代了普通梯度。
这减少了读取中无关的符号,并揭示了一些比J-Lens早的中间概念.

blocks.en:
The original J-Lens ranks individual vocabulary tokens ( Gurnee et al., 2026 ) .
However, a concept’s name may span several tokens, and its representation may contain information beyond a single name token.
To recover complete concept names, Gong et al. (2026) introduced Concept Lens, using token readouts and the input context to propose candidates.
It obtains each candidate’s representation from a fixed prompt and scores it against the original hidden state.
These representations support both multi-token concept readout and concept swaps.
In VLMs, a visual concept can also be expressed through different names and related semantic content.
Our proposed MC-Lens therefore constructs a set of vocabulary directions for each concept.
Word-form selection collects alternative forms of its name, while greedy selection chooses directions that capture its representation, including directions for related concepts.
We use these sets to read visual concepts and test their roles in downstream computation through counterfactual interventions.
blocks.zh:
最初的J-Lens对单个词汇符号进行排序(Gurnee等人,2026年).
然而,一个概念的名称可能跨越若干个符号,其表示可能包含一个单一名称符号以外的信息。
为了恢复完整的概念名称,Gong等人(2026年)引入了Concept Lens,使用符号朗读和输入语境推荐候选人.
它通过一个固定的提示获得每个候选人的代表资格,并根据原始隐藏状态进行评分。
这些表示支持多键概念读取和概念互换.
在VLMs中,视觉概念也可以通过不同名称和相关语义内容来表达.
因此,我们提议的MC-Lens为每个概念构建一套词汇方向。
Word-form选择收集其名称的替代形式,而贪婪的选择则选择能够捕捉其表现的方向,包括相关概念的方向.
我们用这些组合来读取视觉概念,并通过反事实干预来测试其在下游计算中的作用.

blocks.en:
Reading a concept from an intermediate state does not establish that the model uses it in downstream computation. Yang et al. (2024) used gradients to estimate whether stronger recall of an intermediate entity would support the second step of two-hop reasoning.
Across the tested relations, they found substantial evidence for entity recall and moderate evidence for its subsequent use. Gurnee et al. (2026) tested intermediate concepts by swapping their J-Lens coordinates with those of alternative concepts.
These swaps redirected two-hop answers and, in separate experiments, changed answers about different attributes of the same entity. Zahedi et al. (2026) compared concept swaps at different token positions in two-hop capital questions.
The intermediate entity, a state or country, was readable at both the city-name and final prompt positions, but swapping it at the city name redirected answers more often.
To study the use of external evidence, Kawada and Kellis (2026) split the hidden state into the component reconstructed with J-Lens and the remaining component.
They swapped each component between runs that accepted a supplied answer and runs that did not.
In Llama and Qwen, swapping the reconstructed components preserved the rate of accepting a supplied answer, while swapping the remaining components reduced it.
In this paper, we use counterfactual interventions to examine the role of visual concepts in VLM reasoning.
We compare name-token directions with broader concept direction sets and test the necessity and sufficiency of the selected information for correct answers.
We also examine whether the same concept directions influence multiple downstream tasks and successive reasoning steps.
blocks.zh:
从中间状态读取一个概念并不能确定模型在下游计算中使用它. 杨等. (2024)使用梯度来估计更强烈地召回中间实体是否会支持双跳推理的第二步.
在经过测试的关系中,他们发现了实体召回的实质性证据,以及随后使用的温和证据。 Gurnee等人(2026年)测试了中间概念,将其J-Lens坐标与替代概念的坐标互换。
这些互换重定向了双跳答案,并在单独的实验中,更改了相同实体不同属性的答案. Zahedi等人(2026年)比较了两跳资本问题中不同象征性位置的概念互换.
中间实体,一个国家或国家,既可在城市名称中读取,也可在最后的即时位置上读取,但在城市名称中互换,更经常地重定向答案。
为了研究外部证据的使用,川田和凯利斯(2026年)将隐藏状态拆分为由J-Lens和剩余组件重建的组件.
他们将每个组件互换为接受所提供答案的运行和不接受的运行。
在Llama和Quen中,将重建的组件进行互换,保留了接受所提供答案的速度,而将其余组件进行互换则降低了这一速度.
在本文中,我们使用反事实干预来审查视觉概念在VLM推理中的作用.
我们把点名方向与更广泛的概念方向集进行比较,并测试选定信息的必要性和充分性,以便找到正确的答案。
我们还审查同一个概念方向是否影响多个下游任务和连续的推理步骤.

blocks.en:
Mechanistic interpretability studies have also examined how VLMs represent visual information and use it to answer questions. Fu et al. (2025) compared VLM answers with direct readouts from visual encoder features on the same tasks.
These readouts achieved better task performance, and the relevant visual information remained accessible in the connector and decoder.
To trace how visual information reaches the answer, Salazar et al. (2026) used activation patching between paired examples.
They found that open-ended object recognition relied on image tokens, while spatial judgements used visual information transferred to question tokens. Krojer et al. (2026) introduced LatentLens to interpret visual tokens by comparing them with contextualised text representations.
It retrieved descriptions of image regions even in early layers, where direct vocabulary projection was less informative.
The authors also found that, during connector training, visual representations became interpretable first near the language model’s input and later in deeper layers.
blocks.zh:
机械解释性研究也研究了VLM如何代表视觉信息,并用它来回答问题. Fu et al. (2025)比较了VLM的答案,并直接从视觉编码器的功能读取到同样的任务.
这些读取取得了更好的任务性能,相关的视觉信息仍然可以在连接器和解码器中访问.
为了追踪视觉信息是如何到达答案的,Salazar等人(2026年)在对齐的例子之间使用了激活补丁.
他们发现,开放式物体识别依赖于图像符号,而空间判断则使用被传输到质疑符号的视觉信息. Krojer 等人著. (2026)引入了LatentLens,通过将视觉符号与背景化的文本表述进行比较来解释视觉符号.
它检索了图像区域的描述,甚至在早期的地层中,直接的词汇投影资料较少。
作者还发现,在连接器培训期间,视觉表现首先可以在语言模型输入处附近进行解释,后来在更深层中进行解释。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we use our proposed MC-Lens to examine the development of cross-modal concept alignment and selective access during controlled vision-language alignment training.
Our readouts show that concept accessibility improves early in training, while reliable selective access according to the question develops later.
blocks.zh:

我们的阅读表明,概念的可获取性在培训初期就有所改善,而根据问题进行的可靠的选择性可获取性则在以后发展。

blocks.en: 10 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 10. 结论

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce MC-Lens to access concept information from intermediate visual and language states in a shared semantic space.
Using MC-Lens, we examine concept accessibility and selective access, the role of concepts in downstream reasoning, the development of cross-modal alignment during training, and shared workspace functions across VLMs.
Our work provides an experimental basis for studying GWT in multimodal artificial systems.
It also opens a way to investigate how GWT can guide improvements in cross-modal alignment.
Further investigation of the mechanisms that make selected information available to different downstream processes could deepen our understanding of workspace functions and contribute to research on machine consciousness.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们介绍MC-Lens在共享语义空间中访问中间视觉和语言状态的概念信息.
利用MC-Lens,我们审查概念的可获取性和选择性的可获取性,概念在下游推理中的作用,在培训期间发展跨模式的对接,以及跨VLM共享的工作空间功能.
我们的工作为在多式联运人工系统中研究GWT提供了实验基础.
它还为调查GWT如何指导改进跨模式对齐提供了一种途径。
进一步调查向不同下游进程提供某些信息的机制,可以加深我们对工作空间功能的理解,有助于机器意识的研究。

blocks.en: A.4 Estimating Workspace Boundaries

blocks.en:
We manually estimate the workspace intervals shown in Section 6 by examining structural and readout changes across decoder layers.
For Qwen and DeepSeek, changes in vocabulary-direction geometry and effective dimensionality help identify the transition into the workspace.
For Gemma, where these structural changes are less distinct, the entry estimates rely more on prediction agreement, concept readout and query-dependent selection.

在靠近解码器末端的固定末端编辑层,因此,更宽的窗口为一跳任务提供了更大的好处.
